tei:div.tei:p: (rtsa ba'i ma dpe ltar zhus dag pa'o/) (oṃ)༄༅// dpal sdom drug pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i bcud// dpa' mo mkha' spyod dga' ma'i nye lam mchog /dpal ldan sa skya'i bla chen gser chos gang*// dpal mchog he ru ka dpal tshar pa rje'i// gsung gi bcud 'di 'di phyir phan 'dod rnams// brtson pas bsgrubs na na rga 'chi ba las// nges par legs grol grol ba mchog 'grub pas// zin bris 'di yang yang dag lam chen yin// ༈ /oṃ na maḥshrī badz+ra gu ra we/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rje btsun rdo rje 'chang chen po blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po sku drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa'i zhal snga nas kyi zhabs kyi pad+mo la dus thams cad du phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'dir dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa gcig pa'i lam/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i rgyud kyi bcud phyung ba/ grub pa mchog gi dbang po rje btsun nā ro pas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid la dngos su nod de/ 'phags yul rgya gar du gnyis skyes

gnyis skyes te bram ze'i rigs las 'khrungs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta ma na ka shrī dang*/ rat+na rak+ṣi ta/ mchog gnyis la sogs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta bcu gnyis tsam dang*/ bod yul gyi lho brag mar pa la sogs pa dka' ba du ma spyad pa'i slob ma gzhan su la'ang ma gnang bar/ bal po pham mthing pa sku mched kho na la gnang ba'i gdams pa bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la rnal 'byor bla med dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu bzhugs pa'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa/ lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi nang tshan mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhar las 'byung ba dmar mo skor gsum zhes grags pa'i snying po/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi gdams pa nyams su len par byed pa la gang gis sgrub pa'i gang zag des bsgrub pa'i lam dngos/ lam des 'grub pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum las/ dang po la/ smin lam la 'jug rung gi gang zag dang*/ grol lam sgom rung gi gang zag gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyir rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid phal che ba dang ldan zhing*/ khyad par rnal 'byor gsang mtha' lū nag gang yang rung ba'i bcos ma'i dkyil 'khor gnyis su dbang bskur thob pa/ 'bring bde mchog gang rung*/ tha na'ang kye rdor man ngag lugs lta bu ma rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gang rung du dbang bzhi rdzogs par thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom par ldan pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu des rang gi lus ngag yid gsum gdod ma nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku gsung thugs su gnas pa ngo sprod par byed pa'i thabs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs legs par thob cing*/ chag med du nyams su len par 'dod pa'o// des sgrub pa'i lam dngos la/ gang zag dbang po rab bzlas bsgom kho na chag med du nyams su blangs/ gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin par byas/ tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis kyi mchod pa la brtson par byas pa tsam gyis/

re zhig nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal gyi bud med kyi rnam par 'byon zhing*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin pa la yin par ngo shes te/ des rnal 'byor pa'i lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du 'khyer ba dang*/ 'bring de ltar nyams su blangs kyang rtags sogs ci yang ma byung na/ gzhi'i bsnyen pa yi ge'i grangs kyi 'bum tshar so gnyis tsam bzlas pa'i bsnyen pa dang*/ laṅka li'i shing la bstan nas sin+dhu ra bsgrub pa'i sgrub pa byas/ de rjes sin+dhu ra des rang gi dpral bar dga' ba 'khyil pa bri zhing*/ 'phang ra lta bu bud med mang du tshogs pa'i sar phyin nas rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal brtan pos bltas pa'i tshe/ bud med gang gi dpral bar me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba bzhin/ dga' 'khyil 'phos na/ de nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin nges pas/ g.yon nas bskor ba sogs gsol ba btab pas/ des rang gi mkhrig ma nas bzung te mkha' spyod du 'khyer bas/ 'bring bsnyen sgrub las sbyor la bstan pa dang*/ gang zag tha mas de lta bu bya bas ma grub pa'am/ grub kyang ji lta ba bzhin ma byung na/ da dung sgyid lug mi bya bar bzlas bsgom nan tan du nyams su blangs pas/ nam zhig 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku las bar dor langs pa na/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgom bzlas byed pa'i snang ba 'byung zhing*/ de la brten nas dus de nyid du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma (mkha' spyod dpa' bo'i )mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pas/ sgrub pa po de seṅge'i khri la bzhag 'ja'i gur phub/ me tog gi char 'bebs bzhin pas/ mkha' spyod du khyer ba ni nges pa yin pas rab 'bring gsum mam/ shin tu tha ma skye ba brgyud nas dngos grub thob pa ste/ smon lam gyi lam dang bzhir yod kyang*/ de thams cad kyi thun mong gi nyams len rnal 'byor bcu gcig po 'dir 'dus la/ de yang gang zhe na/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go

/zhes pa'i 'di yin/ de la bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa bskyed rim gyi bya ba'i rnam bshad/ dpyad don nyams su len pa la sems 'dzin gyi bya ba gnyis las/ (ka) 1)dang po ni/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i sngon du ldang dgos shing*/ de'i yang sngon du nyal dgos pas na/ thog mar nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'di la'ang gang zag gis dbye bas nyal lugs mi 'dra ba gnyis 'byung ste/ de yang gang zag spros pa la mi dga' ba'am/ stong nyid la mos pa'i dbang du byas na/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i stong nyid kyi ngang la rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par nyal bar byed/ gnyis pa gang zag spros pa la dga' ba'am/ bskyed rim la mos pa ni/ gnas khang chos 'byung dmar po 'od kyi rang bzhin du gsal ba'i ngang du seṅge'i khri la/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan med pa'i rnam pa can du gsal ba'i mgo bo'i thad du seṅge'i khri la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pas bzhugs pa la/ mos gus drag po dung dung pa byas shing bla ma dang lhar gsal ba yang nas yang du gsal 'debs shing*/ rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par gnyid log cing*/ nam sad pa na'ang dmigs pa ma brjed par gsal 'debs bzhin pa'i ngang nas gnyid log par byed/ de yang sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten 'jigs pa/ bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba/ rang gzhan thams cad nyams len gyi rtsis ma zin par/ gti mug gis kun nas bslangs te/ dud 'gro bzhin du gnyid log pa thams cad sbyong byed nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi rnam par bsgyur te/ sbyangs 'bras dag pa'i snang bas rgyas btab ste bsgoms pas 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon du byed pa yin no gsung*/ gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ de ltar nyal lugs gnyis byung ba la brten nas/ ldang lugs kyang gnyis te/ de'ang nam gyi brgyad cha tsam na/

nam mkha' las mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis ḍā ma ru'i sgra khro lo lo bsgrags pa na/ de'i sgra de rje btsun yab dang thun mong du yi ge bdun pa'am/ thun mong ma yin pa nye snying oṃ gsum ma'i sgrar lhang lhang grags pa'i rkyen gyis gnyid sad par bsam la nyal lugs snga ma ltar byas na/ 'od gsal stong nyid de'i ngang las chu las nya 'phar ba'i tshul du rang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan spangs pa'i skur lam gyis ldang*/ phyi ma ltar na rang lhar gsal ba dang*/ mdun gyi bla ma dang bcas pa gsal ba'i ngang nas gnas khang la bltas pas/ dag gsal gnyis med kyi ngo bo chos 'byung dmar po/ grogs sogs ni rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal btab/ mdun gyi bla ma la ched du mos gus byas pas 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pas/ rang sngar bas kyang gsal bar bsam/ de yang sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa/ bcud kyi sems can skye ba/ rang gzhan thams cad la gnyid sad pa'i snang ba bun long du 'char ba 'di rnams/ sbyong byed kyi rnal 'byor 'dis sbyang ba yin no gsung*/ gsum pa bdud rtsi myang ba ni/ de nas 'byor na bdud rtsi ril bu rab gsum/ 'bring gnyis/ ma 'byor na bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa'i chang ngam/ byin rlabs byas pa'i chang la oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod cing g.yon gyi mtheb srin gyis/ g.yon skor du chos 'byung bris pa'i dbus nas bdud rtsi blangs te/ lce la bzhag cing myong bas/ lus kyi nang thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsis mer gyis khengs pas/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad nyi ma shar bas mun pa rang sangs la song ba bzhin du sangs kyis dag bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyes/ bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma thams cad snying ga na sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo bam̐ yig dmar por gsal ba la thim pas/ de nyid nyi ma bye ba 'bum gyi gzi 'od dang ldan par gyur te/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres pa de'i ngang la brjod med du cham me bzhag de yang sbyang gzhi rang gzhan thams cad bza' btung byed pa'i snang ba dang*/ 'dod sred kyis kun nas blangs pa'i khrus byed pa/ mu stegs byed rnams lus kyi dri ma dag pas sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang bar 'dod pa'i lta log dang*/ der ma zad 'dul ba sogs las kha'i dri sbyang ba sogs kyi ched du khrus bya bar gsungs pa rnams kyang*/ nyams len gyi rtsis ma zin pas myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur bas na/ de dag thams cad sbyong byed bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor 'dis sbyang zhing sbyangs 'bras dag pa'i snang bas rgyas btab te bsgoms pas/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon du byed pa'o zhes gsungs/ de bzhin du rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i nyams len gyi snying po dga' ba gsum yang 'dir 'dus/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba ni sku'i dga' ba/ bdud rtsi myang ba gsung gi dga' ba/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig dang rang sems dbyer med kyi ngang du shig ge bzhag pa ni thugs kyi dga' ba yin no// (ka) 3)gnyis pa dpyad don nyams su len pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la/ lam log pa mu stegs byed las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro/ dman pa nyan rang las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyong bar byed pa yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas/ mthun rkyen tshogs myur du rdzogs pa maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid dang bzhi las/ dang po la'ang*/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ gnas khang 'di nyid tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad dbyings su thim pa'i ngang las zhing yongs su dag pa baiḍūr+ya'i sa gzhi la gser zhun mas mig mang ris su bres pa/ mnan na nem byed cing*/ btegs na spar byed pa/ reg pa na bde ba phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa/ de'i dbus su seṅge brgyad kyis gtegs pa'i khri/

sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa'i mdun du rang*/ rang gi g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du gnod byed/ mtha' bskor kun du rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad khrom tshogs pa bzhin du bsams la/ bdag gzhan thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las thar ba'i ched du/ kha tsam ma yin pa snying gi dkyil rus pa'i khong nas skyabs 'gro byed par bsams la/ bdag dang 'gro ba ma rgan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i zhes sogs bzhi skor lan brgya stong du ma'i bar du byed/ mthar rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ skyabs gsol gyi tshig brjod pas/ bla ma'i sku las 'od zer 'phros sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs sems rtog med chos sku dang*/ lus zag med bde chen gyi sku rdo rje rnal 'byor ma 'ba' zhig tu gyur te/ so so'i zhing du bye'u khyu 'phur ba bzhin du deng gis 'phur song*/ bla ma 'od du zhu rang la thim par bsams nas/ rig pa brjod med kyi ngang du cham me bzhag gnyis pa ni/ sems can thams cad yid yul du byas la/ sems bskyed kyi tshig brgya stong ngam gsum nges par brjod do// (ka) 2)bzhi pa tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ de yang sngon du skyabs su 'gro ba 'gro dgos shing*/ de la gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul ni/ tha mal gyi snang ba thams cad dbyings su thim pa'i zhing yongs su dag pa'i dbus su seṅge'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs par bsam/ de nyid la skyabs yul kun tshang ba yin te/ de yang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad thugs yid gcig tu 'dres pas bla ma kun 'dus/ de yang bla ma'i phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bo yin la/ rnam pa dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyis 'dul bar dgongs nas/

de ltar shar ba ni sangs rgyas dkon mchog de'i thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad ni chos/ phyi nang gi skye mched byang chub sems dpa'i ngo bor bzhugs pa ni dge 'dun/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad de'i bka' nyan gsung bstod kyi tshul du bzhugs pas na/ skyabs gsum thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan ni/ de'i mdun du rang gi g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ rang gi mdun du sdang dgra gdon bgegs kyi gtso bo/ mtha' bskor kun tu rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad thibs se yod par bsam/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid spangs gnyen ro gcig tu gyur te/ bskyab bya skyob byed dang bral ba'i bar/ dgos pa ni bdag gzhan thams cad 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir thog ma med pa nas 'khyams shing 'khyams par gyur pa na/ bde ba 'dod kyang thabs la mi mkhas pas/ sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pa 'di las thar bar bya ba'i phyir du ste/ de la'ang 'jig rten pa'i lha dang srung ma la sogs pa lta ci smos/ tshangs pa brgya byin sogs dang*/ de las kyang ches lhag pa nyan rang byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs kyang*/ rang don du spangs rtogs kyi yon tan mthar ma phyin/ gzhan don du gdul bya gang la gang 'dul ba'i thabs mi mkhas pas na/ gtan gyi skyabs gnas ma yin la/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gcig pu skyabs su gyur pa ste/ de'ang bdag gzhan thams cad kyi bde sdug gi rgyu las 'bras phyin ci ma log par lag mthil du skyu ru ra bzhag pa bzhin mkhyen pas/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyang mnga'/ de ltar mkhyen kyang sdug bsngal skyob par mdzad pa'i brtse ba'i ye shes med na skyabs mi mdzad kyang ma bu gcig pu kho na la brtse ba bzhin du dmigs pa med pa'i snying rje rgyun mi chad pa mnga'/ mkhyen pa dang brtse ba yod kyang nus pa med na/ ma lag zha ma'i bu chus khyer ba bzhin du skyob mi nus kyang nges par 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i nus pa thogs pa med pa mnga' bas na/

mkhyen brtse nus pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba la/ mnga' bar ngo shes thag chod pas/ legs nyes skyid sdug gang byung yang*/ mgon skyabs gzhan mi 'tshol bar/ bla ma dkon mchog la blo snying brang gsum gtad nas skyabs 'gro byed/ de yang brag phug lta bu la char pa skyob pa'i nus pa yod kyang*/ rang gi blo ma bkal bar der ma phyin na/ kha nas brag phug brgya stong bos kyang char pas bangs pa la mi phan/ the tshom med par 'tshang gis phyin na/ nges par skyob pa bzhin du/ blo rgya yengs the tshom pa'i ngang kha nas skyabs 'gro brgya stong du ma byas kyang phan thogs mi 'byung bas/ the tshom gyi spros pa bcad 'dun pa rtse gcig tu dril nas/ bdag gi ngag nas brjod pa bzhin du sems can thams cad kyis brjod/ bdag gis 'dun pa byed pa bzhin du sems can thams cad kyis byed par bsams la/ skyabs 'gro la 'bad tshul ni/ sangs rgyas la ston pa/ chos la lam/ dge 'dun la lam bsgrub pa'i zla grogs zhu ba'i 'dun pas/ bdag dang 'gro ba zhes sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan rnams yid la bya/ bla ma la zhes pa'i tshe/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos su bzhugs pa la sems gtad/ sangs rgyas la zhes pa'i tshe/ de nyid kyi phung khams rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bor bzhugs pa dang*/ chos kyi tshe thugs rgyud kyi spangs rtogs/ dge 'dun gyi tshe/ phyi nang gi skye mched sems dpa' yab yum du bzhugs pa la sems gtad nas skyabs su 'gro/ de yang sbyang gzhi thog ma med pa nas skyabs gnas su mi 'os pa du ma la skyabs zhus te/ las ngan ji snyed bsags pa thams cad/ sbyong byed rnal 'byor 'di'i rnam par bsgyur nas nyams su len pa'o// tshad med dngos la/ sems bskyed dang tshad med rgyu 'bras su song ba dang*/ de gnyis ngo bo gcig tu song ba gnyis las/ dang po 'phags pa rin po che'i sgrub thabs su gsung*/

phyi ma nā ro pa dang*/ sa chen gyi gzhung du 'byung bas/ de ltar bya gsung ngo*// (kha) 1)lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ de'ang bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ kyai rdo rjer/ gzhan gyi brjod min lhan cig skyes// zhes sogs gsungs te/ de'ang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang tshe 'dir thob pa la/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i don rtogs dgos la/ de nyid lung rigs gtan tshigs gang gi sgo nas kyang brjod par mi nus te/ kha dog yi ge yon tan dpe bral ba// smra ru mi btub gyi na tsam gyis mtshon// zhes gsungs/ ngag gi lam las 'das par ma zad/ rang gi lus kyi phyi nang don snying*/ phyi rol ri rab khang khyim sogs gang du btsal kyang*/ sems la dbyibs kha dog ngos bzung ma grub pa'i phyir/ rnyed par mi 'gyur/ 'o na rtogs pa'i thabs ye med pa yin nam zhe na ma yin te/ bla ma'i byin rlabs tsam gyis ni// skad cig nyid la 'byung gang yin// zhes sogs dang*/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces sogs gsungs pa ltar/ bla ma dam pa la brten nas bsod nams kyi tshogs rdzogs par byas pa las/ gnas lugs kyi don rtogs par 'gyur zhing*/ bsod nams gsog pa'i yul sangs rgyas dang*/ yi dam sogs bzang po gzhan yod bzhin du/ bla ma bsngags pa ci yin zhe na/ sangs rgyas dang yi dam sogs de dag khyad par 'phags kyang*/ las ngan can du ma tshogs pa'i dus 'dir sku dngos su mthong ba dang*/ gsung dngos su thos pa'i yul du ma gyur pa la brten nas/ thugs gnyis med kyi byin rlabs rgyud la 'jug mi nus pa la/ bla ma dam pa ni/ de dag gi sprul pa'am/ byin rlabs la brten nas so so'i skye bo tha mal pa dang ris mthun pa'i rnam par bstan pas/ sku dngos su mthong*/ gsung gi bdud rtsi thob cing nyams su blangs pas/ re zhig nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rgyud la shar te 'tshang rgya bas na/

bla ma dang sangs rgyas la spangs rtogs kyi yon tan la khyad par med kyang*/ sku drin gyi sgo nas bla ma lhag pa yin/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshul la'ang*/ mtho brtsegs su bsgom pa/ khrom tshogs su bsgom pa/ kun 'dus nor bu lugs su bsgom pa rnams 'byung ba la/ 'dir spros pa chung ba'i dbang du byas nas/ nor bu lugs su sgom par byed/ de yang mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge brgyad kha phyir bstan nas btegs pa'i khri'i steng du/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la ngo bo rtsa ba'i bla mar bsgoms pas byin rlabs myur zhing rnam pa sangs rgyas su bsgoms pas byin rlabs che ba ste/ so skye tha mal pa'i rnam pa'i sku lus de sbyang gzhi'i rten yin pas/ de la dag bya dag byed sbyar du med pas/ nges par rnam pa sangs rgyas su sgom par byed/ de yang lhag pa'i lha gang yang rung ba'i rnam par bsgom pa yod kyang*/ 'dir bla ma'i gsung gis slob ma'i shes rgyud la phan 'dogs pa'i rten 'brel du/ gsung rdo rje dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du sgom par byed/ 'di la thun mong ba dpa' bo rdo rje chos dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam par bsgom pa gnyis las/ 'dir gzhung gi dngos bstan dpa' bo rdo rje chos su bsgom pa ste/ sku mdog dmar po ni bla ma'i thugs slob ma la rjes su chags pa'i mtshon/ g.yas thod pa'i ḍā ma ru rgyun mi 'chad par khro lo lo 'khrol ba ni/ bde stong gnyis med kyi chos sgra sgrogs pa/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bsnams pa ni/ de lta bu'i lam de nyams su blangs pas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba mtshon pa yin gsungs/ de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi nges shes drag pos dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bor gyur pa sogs kyis gsol ba 'debs par byed pa ni/ gzhung gzhan nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags 'byung ba'i dod yin la/

de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma de nyid dbu'i gtsug tor nas yas mar 'od du ltems zhu/ gdan seng khri nas mas yar 'od du zhu ste thugs ka'i thad du 'od phung nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od dang ldan par gyur pa de nyid rang gi spyi bo nas sib kyis thim pas/ bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med 'dres pa'i ngang las bcas bcos mi bya bar rig pa brjod med du ci gnas su 'jog pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// de'ang sbyang gzhi skye ba 'di'i snga ma rigs drug gang yang rung ba'i lus rten la brten nas/ yar sangs rgyas nas mar 'bu srin gyi bar du ma zhig la chags sdang gti mug gis kun nas bslangs pa'i las ngan du ma zhig bsags yod la/ sbyong byed kyang*/ las bsags yul mchog dman thams cad sbyong byed bla ma la skyabs gnas kun 'dus dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam par gsal ba la/ bsags pa'i las thams cad sbyong byed bsod nams tshogs gsog bla ma'i rnal 'byor 'di lta bu'i rnam par bsgyur nas nyams su blangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas kyi ye shes mngon du byed pa yin la/ sbyang gzhi de lta bu'i sems can las ngan thams cad bsags zin pa'i rjes su 'byung ba phra rags rim gyis thim nas 'chi ba'i snang ba 'char ba de nyid/ sbyong byed ye shes tshogs bsags 'dis lam du byed pa yin no gsung*/ dpyad don nyams su len pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ ma rgyud spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ spyi bo'i rdo rje sems dpa' che chung rang gi mtho tshad tsam du bsgom pa bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gsung sgros yin gsung*/ bzhi pa maṇ+ḍal ni/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang rjes su 'brel ba ste/ de bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ gnyis bral 'chad dus zhal shes gsum/

bla ma bskyed pa'i/ bstims pa'i/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab pa'i zhal shes so/ /zhes 'byung ba'i zhal shes dang po/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom ste/ ku sā la'i tshogs gsog lan mang gi mthar/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma grangs ci mang lag len ltar 'bul/ skabs su so bdun ma'ang spro na byed/ de nas gsol ba rtse gcig btab nas brgyud pa kun bstim pa'i mthar/ dbang bzhi blangs la/ zhal shes gnyis pa bla ma bstim pa'i zhal shes nyams su blangs te/ stong nyid kyi ngang du rig pa gnas tshad du bzhag go/ (ga) 1)drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ sbyang gzhi la/ rgya che ba/ zab pa/ mthar thug gsum las 'dir mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi rang sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba de nyid/ rkyen bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i rkyen gyis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bskyed pa ste/ de'ang gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ni rang sems gsal stong zung 'jug brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'di yin la/ de'i rten 'brel la brten nas/ lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum ma las thob pa'i khams dmar po nyis dwangs kyi sum dwangs kyis gang ba/ a thung skyer tsher shad kyi rnam pa can nam/ 'di pas bam̐ yig gi rnam pa can du bzhugs par bzhed pa de nyid nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin/ de la brten nas phyi rol du/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang*/ gnas so gnyis na rang bzhin gyis bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams ni/ zhing skyes sprul pa'i sku dang*/ der ma zad 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul dang*/ yul gru thams cad du gnas pa'i bud med thams cad ni/ las las skyes pa zhes bya ba dang*/ ma mkha' 'gro ma yin pa'i bu mor skyes pa ni/

rigs las skyes pa/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid rdo rje phag mo zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bsgom par byed pa ni/ sngags las skyes pa zhes bya ba de dag gi rnam par 'char zhing*/ de yang bla ma dam pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i skabs su/ nang dang gsang ba'i phag mo yin pa la yin par ngo sprad/ nges shes bskyed/ de'i rgyun skyong bar byed pa bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pas phyi rol gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma sprul pa'i sku thams cad dbang du 'dus shing*/ de la brten nas lhan skyes kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs pas lhan skyes kyi rtogs pa 'char bas na byin gyis yas rlobs/ rtogs pa mas 'char zhes bya ba yin la/ de'ang ye shes kyi tshogs gsog gi skabs su snang ba thams cad 'od gsal du thim pa'i ngang du bzhag pa ni/ 'chi ba sbyong ba/ de las chos 'byung zla ba bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer gyi spro bsdus 'od kyi gong bur bsgom pa ni/ 'chi ba 'od gsal las bar dor langs pa sbyong*/ de las zhal phyag gi rnam par gsal 'debs pa ni/ skye ba sbyang ba ste/ sbyang gzhi skye shi bar do gsum/ sbyong byed 'di lta bu'i rnam pas lam du byed pa'o// de bzhin du rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i zab gnad bdag gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur zhes 'byung ba'i/ bdag gi gzhi sbyang ba ni/ bla ma bstim pa'i stong nyid de'i ngang las rang gi snying gar e bye ru'i mdog can nyis brtsegs su yongs su gyur pa las/ chos 'byung nyis brtsegs te/ bka' brgyud pa sogs chos 'byung phyi ma gdan thabs dang de'i steng du chos 'byung nang ma langs stabs su bsgom par 'dod kyang*/ rang lugs chos 'byung phyi ma 'od kyi rang bzhin can rtsa ba thur du zug pa/ gdengs ka gyen du phye ba'i nang du chos 'byung gnyis pa phyogs zur bstan gyi rnam pa can/ de'i dbus su zla ba/

de'i dbus su bam̐/ zla ba'i kha mtshams la sngags phreng g.yon skor te/ bam̐ gyi mdun du oṃ gsum/ de nas sarba/ bud+dha/ ḍā ki/ nī ye/ badz+ra/ war+ṇa/ nī ye/ badz+ra/ bai ro/ zhes pa'i bar gnyis sdebs brtsegs/ su ldog pa dang*/ tsa nī ye/ hūm̐ gsum/ phaṭa gsum/ swā hā zhes pa'i hā oṃ gyi logs su khrig ste sleb pa bye ru'i phreng ba lta bur gsal btab/ de dag las 'od zer kha dog sna lnga 'ja' tshon lta bu bun gyis 'phros lus kyi nang thams cad khengs pas sdig sgrib nyes ltung rnam smin gdos bcas kyi lus thams cad sbyangs te 'od phung du bsgom pa'o// gzhi bsgyur ba ni/ de las rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bskyed pa ste/ de'ang 'og tu rnal 'byor pa 'khor ba na gnas kyang 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pa mtshon pa pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i dbus su byang sems kyi lo tog smin zhing 'phel bar byed pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng na/ rang nyid sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sems can la rjes su chags pas sku mdog dmar po pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar la dwangs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas ye shes kyi 'od zer 'phro bas bskal pa'i me lta bu'i gzi brjid 'bar ba/ chos thams cad de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pas zhal gcig pa/ bden pa gnyis thugs su chud pas phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'og 'khor ba'i phyogs su brkyang ste bzung nas nga rgyal la sogs pa'i 'khor ba'i skyon thams cad gcod par mtshon pas 'jol thabs su bsnams pa/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i brdar g.yon zla ba ltar dkar ba'i thod pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi khrag gis gang ba steng phyogs su cung zad yo bar bzung ba'i nang nas khrag gi rgyun dmar chi li li 'bab pa/ bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la mnga' ba'i brdar zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol zhing*/

shes rab stong nyid kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir zhal cung zad g.yon du phyogs pa/ thabs he ru ka dang 'bral ba med pa'i brdar kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dkar po/ yu ba brgyad gzhogs lus dang tshad mnyam pa'i rtsa bar rdo rje phyed pa/ rtse mor sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bum pa'i steng du thod skam sum brtsegs kyi rtse mor rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshon pa'i brdar ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa dang bcas pa/ phrag pa g.yon par rtsa ba mdun dang rtse mo rgyab tu bstan pa bkal ba'i tshul gyis bsnams pa/ kun tu 'dzin pa'i mdud pa grol ba'i brdar/ dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa sil bu ma 'dzings shing ma mdud pas sku sked yan chad si ler khyab pa/ ye shes lnga'i yon tan rdzogs pas mi'i thod pa leb mo sor lnga'i tshad la thod skam gyi gzugs brnyan bris pa lnga'i bar rin po che'i 'khyud mos bsdams shing rin po che'i rtse phran cung zad dang bcas pa'i dbu rgyan dang*/ de las thon pa'i rnam pas dpral ba'i ngos su rus 'phreng gi za ra tshag 'phyang ba/ nang gi ā li kā li dag pa'i brdar thod pa skam po rdzogs pa lnga bcu ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i ro skra'i thag pas brgyus pa'i do shal phrag pa nas brla'i bar du 'phyang ba/ spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna ba gnyis la rna cha/ mgul pa la rus pa'i gzhung gsum gyi bar rus phreng gis sbrel ba'i mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs so so la gdub bu/ 'og lpags ste rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ mchod phyir thogs dang thal ba ni shes rab mtshon byed yin zhing*/ rang nyid shes rab stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo yin pas mi dgos so// snying rje chen pos sems can rjes su 'dzin pa'i brdar/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i chags pa'i gnas nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/

shes rab chen pos gang zag dang chos su mi 'dzin pas/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha sbub tu bsgyel ba'i mgo bo zhe sdang gi gnas snying ga'i thad du bltab pa phrag dog gi gnas dpral ba nas mnan pa/ dga' ba bcu drug rgyas pa'i brdar/ lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can spyi bor rigs kyi bdag po rnam snang he ru ka dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa bsgom/ de'ang rigs bdag rang chas dang*/ dbang bskur nas rgyas 'debs pa gnyis te/ sbyang gzhi rgyal po'i bu lta bu rgyal srid du dbang ma bskur bar mchod yul du mi 'gyur ba zhig dang*/ skyes tsam nas rang gi gzhis sogs dbang ba'i rigs gnyis 'byung ba'i phyi ma dang bstun nas rang chas su bsgom pa ste/ ngag 'don la med pas nges par ma brjed par byed dgos shing*/ bdag bskyed la rang chas 'di ga gzhung dang mthun/ mdun bskyed lta bu spros pa la dga' ba'i tshe dbang bskur rgyas btab byas kyang btub gsung*/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor ma 'di ni spyir sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ bye brag 'khor lo sdom pa lha so bdun po thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa ste/ 'di'i sngags su sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī zhes pa'i don sangs rgyas thams cad kyi mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa yin pas/ 'di nyid bsgoms pas spyi dang bye brag 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad bsgom par 'gyur zhing*/ sngags bzlas pas de thams cad kyis bzlas par 'gyur te/ de la dgongs nas 'khor lo sdom pa lū dril gyi rnam rgyal gyi bum bzlas 'di'i kho nar byed pa dang*/ byin rlabs drug skor gyi skabs su/ 'di'i nye snying gis thams cad byin rlabs byed pa yin gsung*/ bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ gzhan gyi gzhi sbyong ba dang bsgyur ba ste/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs pa bun gyis 'phros/

rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la phog pa tsam gyis sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sangs kyis dag par bsgom pa ni gzhi sbyang ba/ de'i ngang las skad cig la thams cad kyang bde stong gnyis med kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal phyag rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par lam gyis gyur par bsam pa ni gzhi bsgyur ba ste/ de yang phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rang sems kho na'i cho 'phrul yin pa'i don gyis sbyong ba dang bsgyur du btub pa yin gyi rang las tha dad du grub pa zhig yin na/ sbyang bsgyur du mi rung gsungs so// brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ gzhan las ye shes pa dgug gzhug ces 'byung ba'i don te/ de'ang lus kyi phyag rgya ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i bshad rgyud las/ mdzub mo mdud byas zhes sogs gsung ste/ mthe bong gnyis sbyar mdzub mo gnyis mdud/ gung mo gnyis rtse sbyar zhing*/ gzhan rnams 'bar ba ltar byas pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'am/ sam bu ṭa las/ ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya zhes gsungs la/ de nyid dpral bar g.yon du bskor/ rkang pa'i stabs su sogs rgyun du ma grub kyang*/ mig gnyis gyen du zlog ngag tu phaiṃ zhes pa mkha' 'gro ma'i dam tshig gi tshig brjod/ de'ang phaiṃ zhes thung ngu ma yin par phe dang e dang ma ste yi ge gsum gyi gdangs thon tsam bya ste/ pho nya gsum gcig tu bsdus pa'i don yin la/ bod skad khos zhes bya ba yin te/ sngags dang phyag rgya 'dis spyan drangs pas gal te mi 'byon na/ dam tshig nyes pas mgo bo khos bya ba'i don yin gsung*/ bsam bya ni/ snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od dmar po lcags kyu lta bu zhig lus kyi dbus drangs po nas thal te song*/ smin mtshams gnad kyi sgo nas 'thon/ phyogs thams cad du bun gyis song bas/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhan skyes longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ yul nyer bzhi na bzhugs pa'i zhing skyes sprul sku/

'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa thams cad ni sngags skyes te/ pho nya gsum po thams cad steng nas byon pa rnams char chen po 'bab pa bzhin du thibs thibs thibs/ 'og nas byon pa thams cad dbyar gyi sa rlangs thon pa bzhin du bun nu nu/ bar nas byon pa thams cad chos 'khor chen por dge 'dun 'du ba bzhin du 'u ru ru byon pa thams cad/ dzaḥzhes pas rang gi spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas sib kyis thim/ baṃ zhes brjod pas chu la chu bzhag pa bzhin du dbyer med du 'dres/ hoḥzhes pas gnyis med kyi ye shes dbang du gyur te nam yang mi 'bral bar bsam/ phyag rgya ma byas kyang gtub/ spro na kyai rdor bzhin bya/ de nas lag pa pad skor sngon 'gro'i 'khyud rgya bya ba ni/ thabs shes zung 'jug mtshon byed yin gsung*/ ngag tu yo ga shud+dha sogs brjod/ yo ga ni rnal 'byor yin la/ de'i don yang*/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med la// rnal 'byor zhes ni brjod pa yin// zhes pa ltar/ thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i bde chen gyi ye shes su bdag nyid rnam par dag la/ de bzhin du chos thams cad kyang dag go zhes nga rgyal bzung zhing rig pa brjod med du cham me bzhag de yang rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i zab chos pho nya gsum bsre ba zhes bya ba yang 'dir 'dus te/ 'dir cho gas bskyed pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang 'gro ba thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa ni sngags skyes/ yul nyer bzhir bzhugs pa'i rang bzhin gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma ni zhing skyes/ 'og min na bzhugs pa ni lhan skyes te/ de dag rang sems gcig nyid de dang der snang ba yin la/ de nyid 'dir gcig tu bsres te nyams su len pa ni/ skyes bu dam pa kun 'dus pa zhes gsungs pa'i nyams len yin gsung*/ de ltar ye shes pa bcug pas rkyen byas te/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gsal 'debs pa yin te/ 'di la'ang zhal gnyis ma'i rdzogs rim sngags kyi de nyid mthar thug par bsam gsungs pa 'dir blangs pa'i thun mong ba zhig dang*/

thun mong ma yin pa grub chen nā ro pa'i slob bshad snyan brgyud kho nar bzhugs pa gnyis las/ 'dir phyi ma ste/ snying gi dbus las gzhan du ma yin no// de nas go cha bcing ba ni/ gong du lhar bskyed tshar ma thag tu byas kyang rung la/ slob bshad ltar na/ shing gnyis gzer gyis bsdoms pa'i dpes yi dam 'bral med du 'chang ba'i don gyis 'dir mdzad de/ de yang*/ bdag nyid sngags kyi gzugs kyis ni// sgrub pa po la dngos grub ster// zhes gsungs pas ngo bo lha la rnam pa yig 'brur bsgom pa ste/ gnas so sor zla ba'i gdan re re la yi ge breng tshar du bsgom pa ste/ kha'i ni lce'i dkyil dang*/ yan lag thams cad ni tshigs chen brgyad de/ dpung pa dang mkhrig ma gnyis gnyis/ dpyi gnyis dang bol gnyis su bsgom pa'o// (nga ) 1)dgu pa bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis las/ thog mar ngag bzlas ni/ lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs kar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa bsgom ste/ bam̐ las 'od zer dmar po grangs med pa bun gyis 'phros/ rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad sangs kyis dag snying ga'am ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phyir 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ pho nya gsum gyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od dmar po'i rnam pas nam mkha' gang bar byon/ rang nyid dam snying ga'i bam̐ yig la sib kyis thim/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ ji tsam dam bcas pa'i grangs de tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod cing*/ rgya 'byams kyi rnam rtog mang po'i dbang du ma song bar yid rtse gcig tu dmigs pa las ma yengs par bzla bar byed/ de'ang sdom 'byung las/ gzhan du mi 'phro'i tshul gyis ni// de lta'i tshul gyis bzlas pa bya// yul gzhan blo ni 'phro ba yis// bskal par bzlas kyang 'grub mi 'gyur// zhes gsungs pas dmigs pa rtse gcig tu ma bral ba'i ngang nas bzlas brjod byas na/

dus ring po ma yin par byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma gdon mi za bar 'byung la/ dgos med kyi rnam rtog la shes pa rgya yan du btang nas sngags grangs song ba'i grangs ji tsam mang rung byin rlabs mi 'byung bas na/ rang gi ma byung bar lha dang bla ma gdams ngag la 'khang ra byed pa mang du gda' ste chos spangs pa'i las su 'gyur gsung*/ gnyis pa yid bzlas ni/ de nas lus gnad drang po'i ngang nas rlung ro gsum sangs kyis bus/ 'og rlung phyed 'then tsam byas rjes/ steng rlung sa len ma'i tshul du shugs 'jam zhing dal bar rngubs te rdzogs pa dang*/ mchil ma gcig dang mnyam du lte 'og tu ldigs kyis bskyur ba'i rkyen gyis snying ga'i chos 'byung sngags phreng bam̐ yig dang bcas pa lte bar sleb par bsam/ slar 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then nas kha sbyar ci thub bzung ste/ yid kyi lte ba'i sngags phreng klog pa'i tshul gyis yid bzlas bdun nam lnga'am tha na'ang gnyis tsam byas la/ rlung ma thub pa na dal bus rang 'gros su nar gyis btang*/ 'di ni bzlas bsgom rnam pa gnyis la brten nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub par byed pa yin pas gtso bor ngag bzlas kho na la 'bad par bya'o gsung*/ zhar byung rdzogs rim ni/ slar yang kha sbyor te/ sems chos 'byung gi mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du drag la myur ba dmar khyi ri ri 'khor ba la ma yengs par sems gtad/ 'dzin med du chad de 'jog par byed/ slar rlung bzung ba'am ma bzung yang rung ste rang lus 'od kyi rang bzhin dmar khra le ba de'i lus kyi nang dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar gsal rtsa ba gsang gnas su zug pa/ yar sna spyi bo nas sba gug ltar 'khyogs te smin mtshams su had de yod pa gsal 'debs par byed/ de ltar gsal ba'i mas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa mtshal lcog la ma'i khu bas bris pa lta bu nas tsam zhig g.yon skor du drag tu khyi ri ri 'khor ba la sems gtad pas/

de bya 'phur ba bzhin du dbu ma'i nang nas yar dmar khor re gyen du byon/ snang ba thams cad bde cham cham song ste/ snying ga'i nang gi dbu ma'i thad du sleb cing*/ drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad/ de nas yar sna smin mtshams su zug pa de'i nang du dga' ba 'khyil pa dkar po zla shel bzhu ba'i khu bas bris pa lta bu chung ngu zhig g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad pas/ de nyid gyen du ril gyis song*/ spyi gtsug dbu ma'i nang du sleb/ de nas bya nam mkha' nas babs pa bzhin du dbu ma'i nang nas mar kho ro ro babs/ snang ba thams cad stong cham cham song*/ snying ga'i dga' 'khyil dmar po'i steng du babs/ reg la ma 'byar ba tsam du gnyis ka drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad pas phrug gis 'dres nas/ kha dog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can myur du 'khor ba la sems gtad pas je yal la dbu ma'i stong pa dang gnyis med du yal gyis song bar bsams la rig pa brjod med du chad de ci gnas 'jog par byed/ bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying ga'i bam̐ las 'od zer bun gyis 'phros/ gzugs med khams thams cad la reg pa tsam gyis len tshwa chur bcug pa bzhin du 'od sngon po bde ba chen po'i rnam par ltems kyis zhu/ rang nyid kyi lus kyi stod kyi cha la thim/ de bzhin du gzugs khams snod bcud brtan g.yor bcas pa 'od dmar po'i rnam par lus kyi bar gyi cha dang*/ 'dod khams snod bcud brtan g.yo thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam pas zhu ste/ smad kyi cha la thim pas khams gsum thams cad ci yang mi dmigs pa'i stong nyid la blo cham gyis bzhag rang nyid kyang 'od du zhu nas snying ga'i chos 'byung la thim/ de zla ba/ de sngags phreng*/ de bam̐ yig de zla tshes/ de thig le/ de nā da/ de nyid kyang nam mkha' la du ba yal ba ltar bun gyis song nas gang du'ang ma grub pa'i stong nyid kyi ngang rig pa bzo med du had de chad de ci gnas 'jog par byed/

de'ang sbyang gzhi dus gsum du 'brel bar rang gzhan thams cad kyi 'chi ba'i snang ba bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad sbyong byed bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor gyi lam du byas te/ sbyangs 'bras dag pa'i snang ba sangs rgyas kyi chos sku dngos yin snyam pas rgyas btab cing bsgoms pas/ 'bras bu de kho na nyid mngon du byed pa yin gsung*/ bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ dngos dang*/ de'i yan lag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de ltar rim gnyis bzlas pa dang bcas pa las langs te/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug pa na/ stong nyid kyi ngang las chu las chu bur rdol ba ltar/ rang nyid snang stong dbyer med kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang phyag mtshan med pa 'od kyi rang bzhin du langs te/ phyi rol gyi snod bcud gzugs su snang ba thams cad ni/ snang stong dbyer med kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gdod nas bzhugs pa der ngo shes pa byas te/ chags sdang skye ba'i yul gang mthong yang rnam pa la spu ris mi 'byed cing sdang zhen du ma song bar bya/ snyan mi snyan gyi sgra thams cad grags stong dbyer med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i gsung dang*/ dran rtog gi cho 'phrul gang shar yang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i thugs bde stong dbyer med kyi rang bzhin du ngo shes par byas la/ ma yengs par skyong bar bya ste/ mdor na/ thun mtshams kyi bya byed snang grags rigs gsum du ma 'dus pa ni med la/ de dag lam khyer 'di lta bu'i sgo nas lam du ma blangs na/ bskyed rdzogs mog mog thun re tsam byas/ rjes spyod tha mal du lus pa'i chos pa de gzugs brnyan tsam du zad pas/ ci nas kyang dran 'dzin chen pos rjes spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ma yengs par bya gsung*/ gnyis pa yan lag la/ kha zas/ phyi rol mchod pa/ tshogs 'khor/ sbyin sreg tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ gtor ma'i rnal 'byor dang lnga/ dang po rgyas pa byed na bdud rtsi byin rlabs ltar byas/

rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba nas gtum mo'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i khrod kyi snying ga na bla ma yi dam thams cad bzhugs pa la mchod pa'i bsam pas/ kha hom khung lag pa gnyis dgang gzar blugs gzar du gsal bas/ kha zas bdud rtsir gyur pa phul bsams la/ 'dzin zhen med par longs spyod/ de tsam mi nus na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥzhes pa gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo de nyid mchod pa'i bsam pas longs spyod pa ni 'bring po yin la/ bsdu na rang yang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang kha zas kyang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba lha la lha thim pa'i tshul du longs spyod pas/ bu lon du mi 'gyur zhing bde stong gi ye shes skye ba'i grogs su 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang pas mdzad pa'i bdag 'jug gi yi ge bzhin nyams su blang bar bya ste/ 'dis ni dam tshig gi nyes pa thams cad sbyangs/ sa lam gyi yon tan thams cad gong 'phel du gyur pa'i gzhi yin pas lam 'di kho na la nyams len gyi snying por byed pa gnad yin gsung*/ gsum pa ni/ sbyin sreg rgyas pa dang*/ mar me'i sbyin sreg gnyis kyang rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi yi ge bzhin du nyams su len par byed/ bzhi pa tshes bcu'i mchod pa la/ rgyas par byed na sku tshom bu/ gsung bdud rtsi/ thugs sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor rnams bdag 'jug bzhin bshams/ mchod pa lnga dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma gnyis dang bcas pa'ang bshams/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa de la mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams kyang bdag 'jug bzhin bya/ 'bring du byed na sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor tsam dang*/ de'ang ma grub na chang dang tsan+dan dmar po'i khu ba bsres pas chos 'byung gru gsum dbus su thig le dang bcas pa bris la/

bam̐ yig la yan lag bzhi rdzogs su sgrub cing mchod gtor 'bul ba sogs bya'o// de tsam ma grub na/ grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i gzhon nu ma gcig gam lnga la sogs pa bza' btung gya nom pas tshim par bya/ de'ang ma grub na/ sngags kyi dam bca' ji tsam yod pa de tha na'ang nyis ldab tu bzlas na tshes bcu'i mchod pa ma chag par 'gro ba yin no gsung*/ de'ang bsod nams sog par 'dod pas yar gyi tshes bcu dang*/ sgrib pa sbyang bar 'dod pas mar gyi tshes bcu ste gnyis ka'am gang mos la rgyas bsdus ji ltar bya yang*/ ma chag par nyams su blangs na dngos grub myur du 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur bas 'bad rtsol du bya ba gal che'o gsung*/ lnga pa gtor ma ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis rlabs/ phaiṃ dang 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gros bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ de dag gi ljags rdo rje'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bas zag med kyi bde bas mnyes par bsams la rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ gsum ma'i mthar a kā ro btags pa lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ de'ang rje btsun rin po ches zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs dang 'phags pa rin po ches 'di nyid kyi sgrub thabs su gtor sngags/ oṃ badz+ra a ra li hoḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes pas 'bul bar gsungs kyang*/ bla ma rnams kyi gsung sgros la gong ma bzhin 'byung bas de ltar bya/ phyi mchod dang nang mchod 'bul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// zhes sogs sh+lau ka gnyis kyi mthar/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /sogs dang*/ 'chi tshe sogs kyis smon lam gdab/ badz+ra muḥgator mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bya'o// de ltar gang zag rab 'bring tha ma thams cad kyi thun mong gi nyams len du gyur pa/

bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig 'di nyid ma 'khrul bar nyams su blangs pas/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur ba yin te/ 'di nyid bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod ces gsungs kyang*/ don gyis bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ de'ang bla ma 'od du zhu/ rang la thim pa'i stong nyid kyi ngang las/ rang nyid sngags kyi lhar bskyed pa bsnyen sgrub bzhi rdzogs kyi cho gas sgrub pa ni bum dbang gi lam/ snying gar sngags kyi 'khor lo bsgom pa'i chos 'byung phyi ma ni gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo/ nang ma ni lte ba'i a thung mtshon pas na lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo/ zla ba ni snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo zlum po'i dbyibs su bzhugs pa mtshon/ bam̐ yig gi ya ra la wa bzhis mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo mtshon/ sngags phreng gis spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis mtshon pas na rten 'khor lo bzhi la gnad du bsnun par byed pa gsang dbang gi lam/ rdzogs rim gyi tshe steng mkha' spyod kyi 'khor lo la brten nas mi rtog pa sgrub pa/ 'og rlung gi 'khor lo la brten nas bde ba sgrub pa/ bar sngags kyi 'khor lo la brten nas drod sgrub pa rnams kyi/ bar pa la brten nas bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba ni shes rab ye shes kyi lam/ de dag las skyes pa'i nyams zung 'jug brjod bral gyi ngang du 'dzin pa ma zhugs par had de 'jog pa ni dbang bzhi pa'i lam ste/ mngon rtogs dkyus gcig la dbang bzhi char gyi lam tshang ba'i phyir ro gsung*/ de lta bu'i rnal 'byor bcu gcig po sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa'i sgo nas ye ma chag par nyams su blangs/ tshes bcu gnyis la mchod pa dang*/ tshogs gtor gyis mnyes par byed cing gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin par byas te/ bsgom bzlas la 'bad pa tsam gyis/ re zhig na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal gyi bud med kyi rnam pas sgrub pa po de'i mdun du 'byung zhing*/

rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yin par lung bstan/ ngo shes/ de la gsol ba btab pas/ sgrub pa po de'i lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste lus ma spangs par mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khyer la/ der slebs pa tsam gyis zag bcas kyi lus zag med kyi ye shes su dwangs shing*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bla ma mdzad de zab mo'i lam gyis rjes su 'dzin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing du yar song ste chos nyan zhing*/ de la brten nas bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba ni/ gang zag dbang po rab tu gyur pa'o// gal te de ltar ma gyur na/ sin+dhu ra'i sgrub pa bya ste/ de'ang thog mar oṃ gsum ma yi ge'i grangs kyi 'bum tshar gnyis gsum tsam gyis gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin par byas/ de nas shin tu dben pa'i gnas su dkyil 'khor gsum bdag 'jug ji lta ba bzhin dang*/ mchod gtor kyang rgyas par bshams/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrubs te mchod bstod bya/ mdun bskyed spro bsdu bya zhing*/ oṃ gsum ma 'bum phrag bzhi'i sgrub bsnyen byas te/ thun bzhir bcad/ thun re re'i mthar sin+dhu ra'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu/ 'byor na sin+dhu ra thun re la spo zhing ma 'byor na'ang zhag re'i khongs su re re nges par spo la/ par bu lta bu'i snod dga' mor tshags byas/ de lta bu'i tshul gyis gzhi 'bum rdzogs pa dang*/ grogs 'khor lo sdom pa'i gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin pa zhig btsal la sba'i dbyug pa lag pa gnyis snying gar rtse sprad pa'i gru mo phan tshun gyi rtse dang mnyam pa zhig de la gtad de/ des kyang sum bha ni bzla zhing dbyug pa de lag tu bzung*/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ laṅka li ya zhes bya ba'i shing sbubs can zhig bal po phyogs su 'byung bas de nyid dam/ ma 'byor na do rgod pa'i sbubs kyis bya bar gsungs pas/

de lta bu mdzub gang ba'i tshad tsam gad legs par byas/ zhabs su shing srab mo la dga' ba 'khyil pa'i par yod pa zhig gis khrig ste bcad/ de'i phyi nas shog bu lta bus gtum pa kha gcod dam drags dang bcas pa byas te/ gu gul gyis bdug pa tsam byas/ ched du dmigs pa ni ci yang mi dgos/ de nyid rang gi lag par bzung ste/ oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa tsam zhig bzlas pa'i mthar/ snga sor bsgrubs pa'i sin+dhu ra rnams ye ma zag par der blugs la kha dam par bcad/ de nas yar ngo'i tshes bcu la mchod bstod bdag 'jug rgyas par byas la/ srod kyi dus su zla bo dang bcas sin+dhu ra dang dbyug pa khyer/ dur khrod du phyin la/ der sa khru gang tsam brus pa'i nad du/ sin+dhu ra bcug pa'i kha sas legs par bcad cing*/ mis mi shes la rang gis mi nor ba'i mtshan ma byas te/ rang nyid de'i steng du 'dug nas/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal brtan pos oṃ gsum ma'i bzlas pa bya zhing*/ grogs des dbyug pa bzung nas bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir du/ sum bha ni'i bzlas pa kho na byed du bcug la/ srod 'khor gyi bar bzlas pa bya zhing*/ de nas khyim du phyin/ nyin mo phyi rol mchod pa dang*/ bdag 'jug sogs ci 'grub bya/ de nas nub re bzhin de bzhin du byed cing*/ bzlas pa yun je ring je ring la/ nyi shu gsum gyi nub mo mtshan phyed kyi bar du bya/ nyer bzhi la sum gnyis/ nyer lnga'i mtshan thog thag bzlas pa byas la/ nam langs ma thag sin+dhu ra phyungs te khyim du khyer la/ de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag nas phyi mchod dang bdag 'jug rgyas par bya/ nyi ma shar ba na grogs ni mi dgos/ rang gcig pu ku sā la'i chas su zhugs/ sin+dhu ra'i zhabs kyi shog bu bsal te/ dga' 'khyil gyi par dpral bar brgyab ste slar gtum pa'i sin+dhu ra mchan khung g.yon du mis mi mthong bar sbas shing*/ sngar byin gyis rlabs pa'i dbyug pa de khyer nas phyogs thams cad du 'khyams te/

'phang ra lta bu bud med mang du tshogs pa'i sar phyin la/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nga rgyal brtan pos bud med de dag la bltas pa na/ rang gi dpral ba'i dga' ba 'khyil pa de'i gzugs brnyan me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar bud med zhig gi dpral bar 'phos byung na/ de ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin pas the tshom dang 'khu 'khrigs mi bya bar zhabs spyi bos blangs/ g.yon nas bskor ba la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur dang gsol ba btab pas/ nges par dus de nyid kyis mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su khrid par 'gyur te/ de'ang mkha' la spyod pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya ba tshe bskal par thub pa/ lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ rdzu 'phrul gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing du bgrod nus pa zhig yin pas/ rang nyid kyis da ltar gyi lus 'di ma spangs par de lta bu'i rnam pa can du gyur te/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams las chos dngos su thob cing nyams su blangs pas sa lam gyi yon tan gong 'phel du 'gyur te/ lus de nyid kyis phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mngon du byed nus pa ni dbang po 'bring po ste/ de lta bu dang ma 'phrad kyi bar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bzlas bsgom la brtson pa'i ngang nas nang re bzhin sin+dhu ra'i par brgyab ste/ phyogs thams cad du 'khyams par byed pa yin gsung*/ gal te de ltar byas kyang ma grub pa'am/ de lta bu lag tu ma longs pa na/ tshe 'dir mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'gro ba med pa'i phyir/ dbang po tha mar gyur pa yin la/ des kyang 'dun pa drag pos nyams len chag med du bya zhing*/ khyad par 'chi khar rdo rje rnal 'byor mas nges par rjes su 'dzin mod kyang*/ ches myur bar byed pa'i thabs 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su len par byed pa ste/ 'di la rje btsun yab yum zhal sbyor dang*/ rje btsun yum rkyang gi 'pho ba gnyis las/

rang gang mos pa zhig la zhag bdun tsam gyi bar du mtshams dam par bcad la nyams su blangs pas spyi bo skrangs pa dang*/ rnag khrag chu ser rdol ba sogs 'byung zhing*/ rnal 'byor pa de mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i ltas su sgrub khang la 'ja'i gur phub pa dang*/ me tog gi char dang*/ dri bzang po'i ngad ldang ba sogs/ yid ches pa'i mtshan ma sogs byung ba na/ de nas ma brjed tsam bya yi/ drag tu bsgoms na 'pho rab tshe thung zhes gsungs shing*/ ha cang drags na thal ba'i nyan yod pas rtab rtob ma yengs par nyams len gnad du thebs pa nges par byed/ nam zhig dus la babs pa na/ las la sbyor ba ste/ de'ang 'chi ltas brtags pa'i man ngag rnams su 'chi ltas du ma gsungs kyang*/ rna ba lag pa gnyis kyis mnan pa'i tshe 'ur sgra 'byung ba de chad pa dang*/ snga dro'i nyi ma rtse shar gyi tshe nyi ma la rgyab gtad de bsdad pa'i tshe mgo bo'i grib ma la rlangs pa bun ne yod pa nyams pa dang*/ mig gi ya gcig mdzub mos bcir bas 'od dmar 'khyir 'khyir 'byung ba de chad pa dang*/ snga gro nyi ma rtse shar gyi tshe nyi ma la rgyab gtad nas bsdad pa'i tshe/ lag pa g.yas kyi khu tshur dpral bar gtad/ gru mo pus mo'i steng du btsugs pa'i mkhrig ma'i mtshams su mig gzir te bltas pas rbad kyis chad par mthong ba sogs nges pa'i 'chi ltas su gsungs kyang*/ de dag byung ma thag 'pho ba mi bya bar/ tshe sgrub la sogs pa'i rim gro dang dge sbyor bungs bskyed de/ ltas de dag 'gyur na legs/ gal te ma 'gyur na las la sbyar bas bar do'i 'jigs skrag sogs myong mi dgos par nges par mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'gro nges par yin no gsung*/ 'pho ba 'di nyid ngor rdzong kun la med pa'i khyad chos gdung brgyud rim par zhal shes su byon pa'i man ngag yin pas snying gi dkyil du 'chang ba gal che'o gsung ngo*// de dag gis ni bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs dpyod pa'i bskyed rim gyi rnam bzhag rgyas par gsungs kyang snying po mdor bsdus yid la gang zin pa bris pa'o// dpyad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gyi bya ba la/

bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ de yang bla ma rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis chos thams cad 'od gsal du thim pa de'i ngang las rang gi snying gar e e las zhes pa nas/ shud+dho3haṃ gi bar rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar ma chod par drag la myur ba'i tshul du bsgom/ ngag bzlas yid bzlas rdzogs rim zhar byung dang bcas pa bsgom pa'i mthar/ thog mar rang nyid tha mal pa ma yin par/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos yin snyam du nga rgyal la sems 'dzin par byed/ de nas de'ang sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan cha lugs rdzogs pa me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i rnam pa spyi la sems 'dzin par byed/ (ga) 3)de nas spyan dbu ma dbus nag pa/ mtha' skya ba/ spyan rtsa dmar shig ge ba/ spyan g.yon pa gyen la langs pa lta bu la sems 'dzin par byed/ de nas rim bzhin spyan g.yas g.yon/ shangs dmar zur re ba/ shangs sbubs dmar sang nge ba/ zhal cung zad gdangs pa he byas pa lta bu tshems kyi phreng ba dkar zhing dwangs pa bzhi bcu/ mche ba'i myu gu cung zad dang bcas pa/ zhal gyi mchu sgros bim pa ltar dmar zhing legs pa/ mgul pa la sha'i ri mo phyed gsum tsam yod pa/ dbu skra nag po ma 'dzings shing sil bur gyur pas sku rgyab si le khebs pa/ nu 'bur gnyis mkhrang zhing rgyas pa/ g.yas pad+ma rā ga'i lcug phran ltar 'jam zhing mnyan pa brkyangs pas gri gug 'dzin pa/ g.yon thod pa gyen du phyogs par bzung nas khrag gsol ba/ sked pa phra ba/ ro smad rgyas pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed mnan pa ste/ rgyan med pa sems 'dzin par byed/ (nga ) 2)de nas dpral bar ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i thod pa sor lnga pa lnga yi dbu rgyan/ de las 'phyang ba'i rus pa'i drwa ba drwa phyed dang bcas pa/ spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ snyan gnyis la rus pa'i a long*/

mgul par mgul rgyan/ dpung pa gnyis/ phyag gnyis/ zhabs gnyis rnams la rus pa'i gdu bu/ sked par 'og pags/ phrag pa nas brla'i bar du thod skam lnga bcu skra'i skud par brgyus pa'i do shal 'phyang ba/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba rnams la rim bzhin du sems 'dzin par byed pa ste/ spyan dbus ma nas me ri'i bar de dag re re la'ang gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro bcad/ rnam rtog gi dug dbyung*/ zhes gsungs pa'i gnad dang ma bral bas/ reg mthong gi mtshan ma thob kyi bar du nyams su len par byed la/ de bzhin du lus dkyil gyi gtso mo nas 'khor gyi bar re re la'ang spyan dbus ma nas me ri'i bar rim bzhin sems 'dzin par byed/ thun de las ldang bar 'dod pa na/ mngon rtogs dkyus ma las 'byung ba bzhin gyi/ bsam mi khyab thun mong pa'am/ mchog tu gyur pa zhal shes gsum pa nang gi mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'am/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab chig brgyud/ gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas zhus te/ nyams su blangs na mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo ni 'di yin gsungs pas/ snying gi dkyil du sba bar bya'o// de gnyis gang yang rung ba'i sgo nas 'od gsal du bsdus te/ sems ji tsam gnas kyi bar 'jog de nas rang thun gyi mtshams lhar langs te brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' gro ma sogs kyis bstod pa'i mthar/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam 'di byin rlabs shin tu che ba zhig yin pas nyams su len pa rnams kyis nges par bya gsungs te/ de dag ni rten bskyed pa'i rim pa 'khor dang bcas pa'o// dbang bzhi'i lam bzang 'dus pa zab mo'i don// bcu gcig rnal 'byor ldan pa'i nyams len gyis// dug gsum 'khrul pa'i dri ma sbyong byed pa// 'di 'dra nyams su len rnams skal bzang mchog/ ༈ (ca) 1)/gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag

rdzogs rim rgyas pa 'khor lo sdom pa rtsa bshad kyi rgyud thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung ba slob dpon nag po spyod pas bkral ba'i mkha' 'gro'i brda'i skad du o la pa ti/ bod skad du rim pa bzhi zhes grags pa dang*/ 'bring po grub chen rdo rje dril bu pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma las dngos su nos pa'i zab chos dril bu rim lnga byin rlabs dang bcas pa/ bsdus pa grub chen lū hi pas slob dpon sha wa ri pa las nos pa'i rdzogs rim bsdu ba gsum pa zhes bya ba dang*/ rtsa dbu ma dang bde mchog dkar po'i rdzogs rim dang bcas gsum ni/ lū hi pas bkral ba'i lam ste/ de ltar du ma bzhugs kyang de thams cad las zab cing khyad par du 'phags pa rje btsun nā ro ta pas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nyid la dngos su nos pa'i gdams pa/ rje btsun yum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa dbu ma zhes bya ba yin/ de zab pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong gsungs pa gang yin pa// lus kyi de nyid mi shes pas// de dag thams cad 'bras med gsungs// zhes rten sbyang gzhi la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs med pas nyan thos dang rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg par ma zad/ bya spyod rnal 'byor rgyud rnams su gsungs pa'i lam gyi rim pa rnams kyis kyang*/ bskal pa grangs med du ma zhig nas sa bcu gcig pa tsam zhig mngon du byed pa las/ tshe 'dir zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang rnyed par mi nus pas na/ 'bras bu dman pa la dgag sgra bzhag pa zhes bya ba yin la/ de la rten 'khor lo bzhi la bsnun pa'i thabs ston pa'i rdzogs rim rnams khyad par 'phags zhing*/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa ba yang dbu mar 'dus shing*/ der rlung sems zhugs pa la brten nas gnyis med kyi ye shes ma gtogs gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa nam yang skye mi srid pas na/ sbyang gzhi dbu ma gcig pu la gnad du bsnun pas gnyis med ye shes dus ring po ma yin par myur du bskyed par byed pas na shin tu zab pa yin no// de la'ang chos nyid dngos su ston pa dang*/

chos nyid brgyud nas ston pa gnyis las/ dang po phyi'i rgya mtsho blta bar 'dod pa zhig la/ de'i rgyus yod pa zhig gis de ni kha dog sngo ba lbu ba 'khrigs pa/ chu srin la sogs pas gang ba de lta bu yod ces bstan pas/ don spyi'i tshul gyis rnam par 'char ba bzhin du/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa'i brda thabs la brten nas/ chos nyid sems kyi gnas lugs ngo sprad pas/ de nyid don spyi'i don gyi tshul gyi rgyud la skye bar 'gyur la/ gnyis pa ni/ phyi'i rgya mtsho blta bar 'dod pa de la rgya mtsho rang gi mtshan nyid dngos ma bstan kyang*/ lam yig lta bu rgyas par bshad nas/ des ji skad bshad pa'i lam la zhugs te phyin pas/ phyi'i rgya mtsho dngos su mthong nas/ sgro 'dogs thams cad dang bral ba bzhin du/ bskyed rdzogs kyi lam zab mo gnad ma 'khrul bar bstan pa bzhin du nyams su blangs pas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes rgyud la skye/ 'di'i rgyun goms pa las mtshon bya don gyi ye shes mngon du 'gyur ba yin la/ des na skabs 'dir phyi ma chos nyid brgyud nas ston pa'i gdams ngag ston par byed pa la/ dpe gsum gyis don gcig gtan la 'bebs par bya ste/ de'ang bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa dang*/ shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa dang*/ sgyu ma mkhan 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa'o// dang po ni/ srog chags zhig gsod par byed pa na/ gnad mi shes pa du mas srog chags de'i yan lag sogs bcad/ lus thams cad phug kyang srog gi gnad ma shes pas myur du 'chi bar mi 'gyur la/ bshan pa des gang la srog gnas pa'i gnad shes pa la brten nas/ der smyug tshal lam mtshon phra mo cung zad re brgyab pas kyang skad cig la srog 'gags par 'gyur/ de bzhin du sbyang gzhi gang na gnas kyi gnad mi shes par lam la 'bad pa byas kyang bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed mi nus la/ sbyang gzhi'i gnad shes pa'i dmigs pa phra mos kyang lhan skyes kyi ye shes myur du bskyed pa yin gsung*/

gnyis pa ni/ rgya gar lho phyogs ḍā ki nī pa ta zhes bya ba'i yul na shing sbom po'i rigs shig gcod par 'dod pa'i mon pa s+t+wa re thogs pa brgya stong tsam 'tshogs te/ shing gi phyogs re nas bcad tsa na phyogs re nas 'grub te bcad par mi nus la/ shing mkhan shing de'i gnad shes pa zhig gis chu rgyu ba'i gnad yod sar bug pa chung ngu zhig tu gzer btab te bzhag pas/ ring por ma lon par sdong po rang nyid 'gyel bar 'gyur ba bzhin du/ gnad mi shes pa'i lung rigs gtan tshigs du mas kha phyir bltas kyi dpyad pa mang po byas kyang gzung 'dzin je 'phel las rnam rtog gcod par mi nus la/ gnad dang ldan pa'i lam zab mo chung ngu res kyang gnyis snang thams cad rang grol du gcod par nus pa yin gsung*/ gsum pa ni/ rgyal po bho dza de wa zhes bya ba'i khang pa la/ sgo bzhi na shing gi mi hreng ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor rgyun mi chad par bskor bas srung ba'i nang*/ rgya mtsho chen po nya dang chu srin sogs du ma rgyug pa'i rnam pa can du yod pa der 'jug par 'dod pa la 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad mi shes pa brgya stong du mas zhi drag gi thabs ji snyed byas kyang 'jug mi nus la/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad shes pa des skud pa phra mo gcig bcad pa lta bus 'khrul 'khor de dag zhig nas bde blag tu 'jug nus pa bzhin du/ gnad med pa'i 'bad rtsol mang yang dbu mar rlung sems 'jug mi nus la/ gnad dang ldan pa'i man ngag cung zad tsam gyis kyang rlung sems dbu mar myur ba nyid du 'jug nus pa yin gsung*/ de lta bu'i zab gnad dang ldan pa'i lam de nyid nyams su len pa la/ gzhi chos can 'khor ba'i gnad/ lam bsgom pa'i gnad/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnad gsum las dang po ni/ sems can rnams 'chi ba'i dus 'byung ba phra rags rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog dang bcas pa dbyings su thim nas 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang du gnas kyang*/

'od gsal la 'od gsal du ngo ma shes pa'i lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas bslad de bar do'i snang ba 'char la/ de yang gnas pa tsam med pas ming gzhi 'khyams po bya spu rlung gis khyer ba bzhin du phyogs kun du yud yud 'khyams shing*/ 'khrul snang gi gdung ba drag pos nyen nas lus rten 'tshol ba'i snang ba 'byung*/ de la brten nas rigs drug gang du skye 'gyur gyi las bsags pa'i mngal 'dzin la/ de yang mir skye ba'i las bsags pa des/ pha ma gnyis rmi lam gyi snang ba bzhin du mthong ba na/ rang pho mo gang du skye ba'i rten 'brel gyis/ pho la chags shing mo la sdang ba dang*/ de nyid lugs ldog tu shar ba'i chags sdang des nying mtshams su sbyar te/ ma'i mngal du pha'i khams dkar po nyis dwangs gsum dwangs yungs kar gyi 'bru tsam gsum/ ma'i khams dmar po nyis dwangs gsum dwangs yungs 'bru tsam gsum/ bar do'i shes pa dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa na/ bde stong gnyis med kyi ngang du gnyis snang thams cad nub pa'i 'od gsal 'char yang*/ de ngo ma shes pas brgyal ba lta bur 'gyur/ de zhag bdun nas 'di zhes brjod pa thams cad dang bral ba zhig 'dug snyam/ brjod bral la 'dzin pa zhugs pas lte ba'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma rta rnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam a ha na ste mi shigs pa'i yi ge zhes bya ba grub/ yang snang ba thams cad stong pa cir yang ma grub pa zhig yin 'dug pa snyam ste/ stong sang sang stong pa la der 'dzin pa zhugs pas g.yas su ro ma dmar po rta rnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam chags/ yang gsal ba la der 'dzin zhugs pas rkyang ma sngar bzhin du grub ste/ gsal ba la 'phros pa'i rtog pa du ma 'phros pa la brten nas rkyang ma la gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab ji snyed pa rnams grub/ stong par 'dzin pa las 'phros pa'i rtog pa rigs mi 'dra ba du ma 'phros pa'i rkyen gyis ro ma las gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab ji snyed pa grub/

zung 'jug tu zhen pa'i rtog pa rigs mi 'dra ba du ma 'phros pa'i rkyen gyis dbu ma las gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab ji snyed grub/ de dag gi bar rnams su chu rgyus dang rus pa sha khrag pags pa sogs grub cing rim gyis brtas par gyur te/ mer mer po/ nur nur po/ gor gor po/ ltar ltar po/ mkhrang 'gyur/ nya dang*/ rus sbal sogs mngal gyi gnas skabs bcu rim gyis rdzogs nas zla ba dgu'am bcu nas btsa' bar 'gyur la/ rtsa 'dab ji snyed pa de dag gi nang du rlung sems kyis 'gro 'ong byas pa la brten nas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rtog pa ji snyed gcig 'char ba yin gsung*/ des na rtsa grangs med pa de dag thams cad kyang dbu ma nyid du 'dus pas/ de la gnad du bsnun pas gnyis med kyi ye shes myur du bskyed par byed pa'i thabs ni/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa rgyud le'u dang por/ pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma rnams// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ phyi nang gsang ba'i pho nya mchog 'bring tha ma gsum las/ 'dir nang gi pho nya mchog rtsa dbu ma/ 'bring pu li ra la sogs yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa/ tha ma ba spu bye ba phrag phyed bzhi'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i rtsa phran rnams yin la/ de dag la pho nya zhes 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ 'jig rten na rgyal po'i bya ba myur du 'grub pa de la pho nya'am bang chen nam bya ma rta zhes brjod pa bzhin du/ 'di yang gnyis med kyi ye shes myur du skye ba'i don gyis pho nya zhes bya la/ mchog 'bring gi don ni rtsa phran gzhan rnams la gnad du bsnun pas/ bde chen gyi ye shes dus re zhig nas skye bas na de ni pho nya tha ma/ de nas yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa rnams 'bring*/ de las kyang ches myur bas dbu ma ni mchog yin la/ de bzhin du/ rnal 'byor pa yis khyad par du// rigs ldan ma rnams rtag mchod bya// zhes gsungs pa'i don/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rigs ldan ma las/ 'dir nang gi rigs ldan ma mchog dbu ma mchod pa yin zhing*/

thun mong gi rgyu mtshan/ mtshan yang dag par brjod par/ ma rig sgo nga'i sbubs 'byed pa// zhes man ngag gi gnad mi shes pa rnams kyis dbu ma kha 'byed mi nus pas na/ ma rig sgo nga yin la/ 'dir bla ma'i man ngag gis sgo nga'i sbubs phye ste/ dbu mar rlung sems 'dus pas rig pa'i ye shes bskyed pa'i thabs so// mdor na nang gi pho nya mchog rigs ldan ma rtsa dbu ma'i kha phye ste/ bde stong gi ting nge 'dzin skyed par byed pa ste/ sbyang gzhi thams cad kyi gtso bo rtsa dbu ma 'khor lo thams cad kyi gtso bo lte ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de'ang snying ga nas rje btsun yab kyi ngo bo bha san+ta'am/ dpyid ces bya ba bde chen gyi ye shes kyi ngo bo hūm̐ cha lnga pa'i rnam par bzhugs la/ dpyid ces bya ba'i don yang*/ 'jig rten na dgun grang ba dang*/ dbyar char pa dang ser ba sogs kyi rdul dang bcas pa yin la/ dpyid grang dro snyoms shing ljon shing me tog la sogs pa rgyas pa'i rten 'brel gyis sems can thams cad bde ba'am chags pa che ba'i dus yin pa ltar/ 'di la'ang gnad du bsnun pas bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed pa'i don gyis dpyid ces btags pa yin la/ nam zla dpyid ka 'byung ba yang sa chu dros pa la rag las pa bzhin du snying ga'i dpyid bskul bar byed pa'ang lte ba nas rje btsun yum gyi ngo bo lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum khams dmar po nyis dwangs sum dwangs dang bcas pa a thung skyer tsher ram shad kyi rnam pa can/ 'di bas bam̐ gyi rnam pa can bzhugs pa'i ti la ka zhes pa de yin la/ dpyid thig gam nang gi he ru ka yab yum zhes bya ba yin yang*/ 'dir rje btsun yab kyi ngo bo bha san+ta re zhig btang snyoms su bzhag nas/ rje btsun yum gyi ngo bo ti la ka gnad du bsnun pas mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi gsang ba'i pho nya mchog chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs brjod bral blo 'das bsam gyis mi khyab ces brjod pa'i don dang*/

zab pa'i sbyang gzhi nang gi pho nya mchog dbu ma la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs la/ chags can pho nya'i lam la dga' ba dang*/ chags bral rnal 'byor gyi lam la dga' ba gnyis las/ phyi ma la'ang dbu ma la rlung sems bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bsdus nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi stan la rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam gzhag mthe bong lto sbyar/ lto ba bcar ba/ sgal tshigs drang por bsrangs/ ol kos ol mdud non pa tsam bya/ mig smin mtshams kyi thad sna rtser had de blta ba sogs rnam snang gi chos bdun dang ldan pas skyabs 'gro nas yid bzlas kyi bar ram/ yang na bla ma dang rang sems 'dres pa'i ngang las skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par lam gyis gsal ba'i lus thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin dmar khral le ba'i dbus drang por/ rtsa dbu ma sbom phra mda' smyug 'bring po tsam/ yar sna tshangs bug dang mar sna gsang gnas kyi rtser zug pa'i g.yas g.yon du ro rkyang gnyis gro sog 'bring po tsam yar sna tshangs bug nas 'khyogs te/ sna bug gnyis la had de zug pa/ mar sna dbu ma dang mnyam du zug pa/ gsum ka'ang reg la ma 'byar ba 'od kyi rang bzhin dwangs sang nge ba'i lte ba'i thad du sbubs cig tu gyur pa stong sang nge ba/ de'i nang du yi ge ram̐ yig dmar nag drod kyi rang bzhin can ril ma tsam zhig bsgom par byed/ de nas thog ma sna bug g.yon la sems gtad nas rlung ro bus/ de nas g.yas/ de nas dbus/ yang g.yon g.yas dbus nas lan gnyis re ste dgu phrugs su sangs kyis bus pa'i rjes su/ 'og rlung snyan gsan 'bebs pa'i tshul du phyed 'then tsam byas/ steng rlung sa len ma byas te lte 'og tu chir gyis mnan/ slar 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gsum tsam byas te/ shugs rdzogs par 'then nas lte bar kha sbyar te bzung*/ sems kyis rlung gnyis pos ram̐ las bus pa'i rkyen gyis ram̐ de mer dmar hur gyis gyur te/

lte ba'i rtsa sbubs dmar dwangs se drod tsha 'ur re ba la sems gtad de/ gsal theb pa dang 'dzin med du cham me 'jog rtog pa 'phro na ram̐ yig nyid gsal 'debs par byed la/ de'ang rnam pa gsal po ma byung na drod mi skye bas/ thog mar gsal legs po btab/ 'dzin med du ma bzhag na bde chen gyi ye shes skye ba'i rgyur mi 'gro bas na/ mu stegs byed kyi gtum mo dang khyad med du 'gyur ro gsung*/ de lta bu'i ngang nas rlung zug la sogs pa cher ma skyes kyi bar du bzung*/ de nas kyang bzung na gegs kyi rgyur 'gro bas 'jam zhing dal ba sna'i spu mi 'gul ba tsam du rang 'gros su shad kyis drangs/ 'og rlung 'then pa ma byas na rlung gi yon tan mi skye bas rgyun du thun re byas pa'i ngang nas/ sngar gyi bum pa can thun re la nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs ci thub bzung bas/ lte bar drod 'bar ram lus khol por drod tsha chil skye ba sogs byung na/ ram̐ me 'bar ba'i bar sngar bzhin las/ de ltar 'bar ba'i drod kyis rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i rtsa thams cad kyi nang na gnas pa'i khams snyigs ma thams cad rang shugs kyis cham cham skam/ dwangs ma rnams chu'i rang bzhin yin pas ro rkyang gnyis kyi nang nas mar bde chi li li babs/ lte ba'i sbubs stong de nyid mer gyis khengs pa la sems gtad/ slar 'og rlung cung zad 'then pa'i rkyen gyis ro rkyang gi mas snar dbu ma'i nang du zhugs te/ thig le thams cad dbu ma'i nang nas yar chil gyis song*/ spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi mthar thug pa'i dbu ma'i nang thams cad khams dkar po nyis dwangs sum dwangs dngul chu dwangs ma'i mdog lta bu dran pa tsam gyis bde chen gyi ye shes skye nus pa/ de lta bus ltem gyis gang ba la sems gtad de rig pa 'dzin med du had de 'jog cing rlung yang sngar bzhin 'dzin par byed/

de dag ni rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba'i man ngag ste/ dbu mar rlung sems bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor ro// gnyis pa la/ rlung lus la gnas pa bde ba sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ sems la zhugs pa stong pa sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de nas ro rkyang gnyis dang dbu ma'i nang gi thig le 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur/ dbu ma rkyang par gnas pa'i yar sna spyi bo nas sba gug ltar 'khyog ste smin mtshams su ha re zug pa/ smin mtshams su chos 'byung gru gsum dmar sang nge ba gdengs ka che ba smin mtshams su bstan zhing rtsa ba phra ba dbu ma'i nang du zug pa la bug pa thal le yod pa/ de'i gdengs ka che ba'i nang du thig le kha dog lnga char gcig tu 'dres pa lta bu/ khra khrug khrug pa 'od sol sol phro phro yod pa sran chung tsam/ bde ba'i rang bzhin 'od du hri li li yod pa cig la sems gtad de/ spro na bum pa can byas kyang rung*/ de ltar byas pas smin mtshams su bde lhang ba'am/ tsha zhum pa'am/ na dkar ba'am/ grang lhang ba lta bu gang yang rung ba byung na thig le de smin mtshams nas gyen du hri li li song*/ spyi gtsug gi thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du ri rtser skar ma shar ba bzhin 'od hri li li byed pa la sems gtad/ der yang sngar bzhin rtags byung ba dang*/ thig le de'i khrod nas bde chen gyi ye shes su gyur pa'i thig le shel dkar bzhu ba'i khu ba lta bu sbom phra dar skud tsam zhig skya nar gyis babs/ dbu ma'i nang nas mar bde khri li li song*/ mgrin pa snying ga lte ba rnams su sleb/ rim bzhin bde chen gyi ngang du sems bzung*/ mthar gsang gnas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbyibs su gnas pa'i dbu ma'i mar sna chos 'byung dmar sang nge ba gdengs ka che ba thur la bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba dbu ma'i nang du zug pa/ de'i nang nas mar thal gyis song bas gsang gnas kyi pad+ma'i phyir sor phyed dang gsum nyug ge yod pa la sems gtad nas rig pa brjod med du 'jog par byed/

de ltar byas pas khams 'dzag pa'i bde ba ches mi bzod pa lta bu byung na/ sor phyed sor gang sor do rnams tshod dang sbyar phri nas bsgom pas sel bar 'gyur gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ yang smin mtshams kyi mdzod spur sngar bzhin thig le bsgoms pa nas/ spyi gtsug tu spo ba'i bar 'dra la/ de nas de la dmigs pa gtad pa'i dbang gis de las 'od kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' tshon lta bu bun gyis 'phros/ des gang reg pa'i lus thams cad spyi bo nas rim bzhin 'od kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' tshon lta bu gsal la la song*/ de nas cher 'phros snod bcud thams cad 'od kha dog lnga ldan du bun gyis song ba la sems gtad/ rig pa brjod med du bzhag pas/ 'od phung de dag nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin song ba'am yang na tshur 'dus rang lus la thim/ de spyi bo'i thig le la thim/ de nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar chos nyid du thim par bsams la/ rig pa brjod med du bzhag yang de nas rang nyid skad cig gis lhar gsal ba'am/ thog mar nam mkha' las sprin rdol ba bzhin spyi bo'i thig le de byung*/ de nas rim gyis lhar langs te sngar bzhin bsgom par byed/ de ltar nyams su blang bas lus yang ba dang*/ lag pa la sogs nyi zer la bltas pa na/ phyi gsal nang gsal lta bu 'byung zhing phyi rol du'ang sgrub khang la 'ja' 'dzug pa sogs 'byung la/ de brtan par bya ba'i phyir thog mar rlung gi reg bya lta bu sngar phan mi bzod pa zhig yod pa de/ rang lus snang srid thams cad 'ja' tshon du bun ne ba la dmigs rten byas/ brjod med du bzhag pa na/ sngar rlung 'phog pa'i tshe grang lhang gis mi bzod par 'char ba de nub nas bde chen du lhang gis 'char gyin 'dug na/ me'i 'od dang*/ nyi ma dang chu la sogs pa la'ang sngar bzhin bya/ de nas lag pa lta bu dbyug pas ha cang na ba ma yin par brdungs la/ de tshe sngar bzhin dmigs pa gtad pas bde chen du lhang gis 'char gyin 'dug na dbyug pas cher brdungs pa dang*/

mtshon la sogs pa brgyab kyang skyon du mi 'gyur zhing bde chen gyi ye shes su 'char ba zhig yong la/ (ja)de nas thog mar gsang spyod bya zhing ting nge 'dzin brtan par byas/ rim gyis phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa byas te/ yi dam gyi lhas lung bstan pa'i phyag rgya'i nye rgyus mtshams sbyar te/ sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur ro gsungs/ de ltar na bskyed pa'i rim pa bzlas pa dang bcas pa ni mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs kyi gtso bo yin la/ rdzogs pa'i rim pa rtsa dbu ma ni phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub sgrub pa'i thabs kyi myur lam khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas/ zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa la 'bad par bya'o gsungs/ rgyun gyi nyams su len tshul ni/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin yid bzlas kyi bar byas te/ rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba nas sems la zhugs pa'i bar ram/ bsdu na ni kha dbye ba ma bsgoms kyang rung*/ gang ltar yang 'od gsal las skad cig gis lhar langs la/ nang gi mkha' spyod sgrub pa byas/ slar thun mtshams kyi lhar langs te/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs smon lam rnams tshul bzhin du bya'o// grangs med pho nya'i gtso bo kun 'dar ma// zag med bde chen mchog gis mchod byas nas// brjod med gnas lugs rtogs pa'i nye lam 'di// 'khrul med bla ma'i gsung gi snying khu yin// bgrang yas rgyud sde'i snying po rim gnyis mchog /rab 'byams lam gyi mthar thug dbu ma'i khrid// dpag yas rgyal bas bsngags pa'i zab chos 'di// mtha' yas bsod nams can gyi spyod yul yin// 'di 'dra rgyal ba kun dngos rdo rje 'chang*// tha mal gdul bya'i snang ngor tshar pa rje// pha rgan sku drin dbang po'i gsung gi bcud// snying gi pad+mo bzhad phyir bris pa yin// de skad 'a zhwa'i rigs kyi ldom bu pa// dpal ldan skal bzang dbang po mkhyen brtse'i ming*// rje btsun bla ma'i bran des yi ger bkod// dge bas bla ma'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cig
/'dis kyang slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa phyogs thams cad du rgyas par gyur cig/ ༈ /

rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyi gsung*/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs rgyun gyi nyams len gyi rim pa mdor bsdus bzhugs// ༈ /na mo gu ra we/ (kha) 2)skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas byas nas/ zhal shes dang po mthun rkyen tshogs rdzogs shing byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi khrid la/ tha mal gyi snang ba dbyings su thim pa'i dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi rang snang las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i cod pan can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can/ dar dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od 'bar ba/ dran pa tsam gyis phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la 'khod par nus pa/ gsol ba btab na smos ci dgos pa skyon kun zad/ yon tan kun rdzogs/ sku bzhi'i bdag nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ de'i pad 'dab kyi kha mtshams kyi steng nas sangs rgyas rdo rje chos nas/ rje btsun rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen bslab gsum bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi bar gyi brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams g.yon bskor gyis mu tig bstar la brgyus pa bzhin dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/

g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la babs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor gyur/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha dam can gter bdag dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ skyabs gnas de 'dra ba re la skyabs gnas cha tshang ba re sib ste thim song snyam pas/ ngag tu/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen sogs sh+lau ka gang 'os dang*/ rdo rje 'chang dang sogs kyi brgyud 'debs byas/ sangs rgyas rdo rje chos la gsol ba 'debs so bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la= paṇa chen nā ro ta pa la= pham thing pa sku mched la= klog skya shes rab brtsegs la= mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa la= rje btsun sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po la= slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo la= rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan la= chos rje sa skya paṇa chen la= 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags pa la= zhang dkon mchog dpal la= grub chen brag phug pa la= chos rje bla ma dam pa la= da lta rgyun du mdzad pa ltar na bla ma dam pa'i rjes su yar lung ba seṅge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal mchog 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang sogs 'dra/ chos rje dpal ldan tshul khrims la= shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan la= rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po la= sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan la= bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la=

rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma la= rdo rje 'chang kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros rgyal mtshan la= rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan la= rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la= rdo rje 'chang mkhan chen bslab gsum bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la= slar yang gsol ba phur tshugs su/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ brgya tshar sogs longs skabs dang bstun pa'i mos gus drag pos bya'o// de nas rang gi snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa nam mkha' gang bar spros te/ de yang bdag gzhan thams cad kyi lus longs spyod thams cad mchod pa'i rgyur byas pa'i mchod pa phul bas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyis bdag gir mdzad/ mnyes song snyam pa byas nas lha mo rnams rang la thim pa phyi'i mchod pa'o// yang snying ga nas lha mo thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros/ de dag gis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dag pa ye shes lnga'i bdud rtsi thod pas bcus pa/ bla ma rnams re re la phul bas ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol bas zag med kyi bde bas mnyes par byas nas/ rang la lha mo rnams thim pa ni nang gi mchod pa/ yang rang gi snying ga nas lha mo pad+ma can sogs dpag tu med pa spros/ de dag gis snyan pa'i glu len bde ba'i gar bsgyur nas gcig la gcig thim pa'i tshul gyis mthar rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur pa bla ma de dag la 'khril nas snyoms 'jug gi bde bas mnyes par bsams pa gsang ba'i mchod pa/ de nas mchod yul mchod mkhan mchod pa'i tshul thams cad gang du'ang ma grub pa'i 'dzin med la blo bzhag pa ni de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o// de nas rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam zhig rgyang gis spyi bo nas 'thon/
