des rang gi lus la gzigs pas/ tsho ba snum pa brjid pa che ba zhig khrong nge yod pa de'i smin mtshams la gri gug gis reg tsam byas pa tsam gyis thod pa ling gis bkog thod pa'i sgyed pu gsum rang byung du grub pa'i khar bzhag gri gug gis rang gi lus kyi rkang pa g.yon pa dum bu gsum du gtubs nas thod par bskyur/ de bzhin du g.yas/ lag g.yon/ g.yas/ lus gshags nas stod smad kyi nang khrol/ de nas ro smad/ ro stod sogs lhag ma ma lus pa dum bur byas te bskyur la/ de la bltas pas thod pa je cher stong gsum tsam gyi nang du sha'i ri bo/ rus pa'i gram khrod/ khrag gi rgya mtshor gyur pa de nyid la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs pas ye shes kyi me rang 'bar bas de nyid bkol bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho kha dog dkar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ nus pa phun sum tshogs pa/ dran pa tsam gyis bde chen gyi ye shes bskyed nus pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsams la/ rang gi snying ga nas lha mo thod pa thogs pa gcig spros pa des bdud rtsi nas bcus te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la phul bas ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol bas mnyes par byas nas rang la thim/ yang spro ba sogs gong bzhin lan bdun du bya ba ni kha sbyor yan lag bdun thob par bya ba'i rten 'brel yin gsungs/ yang lha mo sogs dpag med spros/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i mtshan gong ltar la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sbyar ba re re brjod cing bla ma re re la phul nas rang la thim/ yang spros pas bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha gter bdag thams cad la phul bas mnyes nas rang la thim/ yang snying ga nas lha mo nam mkha' gang ba 'phros pas bdud rtsi bcus te rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad dang*/ rang la gnod pa'i lan chags pa'i gdon bgegs la sbyin/ de dag gis myang bas myang grol/

reg pas reg grol/ bdud rtsi mthong ba dang*/ dri tshor ba la sogs pa thams cad tshim zhing*/ sgrib gnyis sbyangs/ tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ sems rtog med chos sku dang*/ lus zag med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur nas lha mo rnams rang la thim/ thod pa bdud rtsi rnams mi dmigs par gyur pa'i ngang las 'dzin med du blo bzhag nas/ khrid kyi skabs 'dir maṇ+ḍal lag len ltar dbul/ de nas/ (kha) 3)dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag la dbang bzhi rdzogs par bskur du gsol/ zhes pa'i gsol 'debs ngag tu lan gsum brjod pas/ rtsa ba'i bla mas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la dbang bzhi bskur mi bskur gyi gnang ba zhu ba'i tshul gyis spyan kho ro ro gzigs pas/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis/ de ltar du dbang bzhi bskur ba'i gnang ba sbyin pa'i tshul gyis spyan hrig hrig gzigs nas/ drin chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan nas bzung ste g.yon skor gyis re re la thim/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku smad la thim nas bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer dkar po 'phros rang gi dpral bar thim pas bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi sgrib pa dag lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul sku thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par bsams la blo bzhag yang bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥyig las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rang gi mgrin par thim pas gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag lam tsaṇ+ḍa li bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam la blo bzhag yang bla ma'i thugs kyi hūm̐ yig las 'od zer mthing ga 'phros rang gi snying gar thim pas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag lam pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ yang bla ma'i gnas gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/

rang gi lus ngag yid gsum la thim pas dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag lam phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs zhugs par bsams la/ sems 'dzin med du ci gnas bzhag yang ngag tu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes brjod cing gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pas/ bla ma de nyid dbu'i gtsug tor nas mar 'od du zhu/ gdan seng khri nas mas yar 'od du zhu ba thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar ser le khri'i mdog can snum pa 'gril ba bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du gyur pa de bde khri li li byung bas rang gi spyi gtsug nas thim pa snying kha'i bam̐ yig dmar po de nyid la sib ste thim pas bam̐ yig de nyid je che la song nas mthar 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur pa'i bla ma dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres pa de'i ngang la sems ji tsam gnas kyi bar bzhag la gshis skye med stong nyid du rjen ne/ gdangs 'gags med mos gus su lam me'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag de nas rang gi snying gar e e las zhes pa nas/ rnam snang gi cod pan ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs kyi 'don cha brjod/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags phreng las zhes pa nas de thams cad rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur zhes pa'i 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor byas/ de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas ngag tu phaiṃ brjod nas ye shes pa bstim/ ye shes pa bcug pa'i rkyen gyis lus dkyil gsal gdab/ ye shes pa dang mi 'bral ba'i phyir go cha'i lha bcings pa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍa ka'i ngo bor gyur zhes brjod/ lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs kar sngags 'khor gsal ba dang*/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdus ngag bzlas ji tsam dam bcas pa'am brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas rjes/

rlung bzung nas yid bzlas zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis rdzogs rim dngos gzhi la rtsa dbu ma kha dbye ba ma bsgoms kyang rung gang bde bya/ bde ba sgrub pa/ 'ja' lus sgrub pa/ bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa rnams kyi dmigs pa ji ltar rigs pa byas/ mthar dge ba 'di yis sogs bsngo ba smon lam dang*/ rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs kyi brgyud 'debs mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba sogs bya'o// gtor ma 'bul na bsam mi khyab kyi nyams len grub mtshams mngon rtogs na bzhugs pa ltar gyi gtor bsngo dang*/ de rjes chos skyong gzhi bdag sogs thams cad la dbul lo// de nas bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis sogs gong bzhin mdzad pa ni/ rgyun gyi nyams len gyi go rim ma 'khrul bar bkod pa yin no// 'dis rje bla ma'i slob bshad zab mo'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig /'di mngon rtogs kyi dkyus na yod pa ltar gzhung dang mi mthun yang slob bshad pa'i bzhed pa ltar/ bla ma'i man ngag snyan brgyud kyi gsungs las 'byung bas 'di kho na ltar nyams khrid du thob pa rnams kyis nyams su blang bar bya'o// ༈ /d+dhi/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i lus dkyil snyan brgyud yid bzhin nor bu bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo badz+ra yo gi ni ye/ rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi lus dkyil snyan brgyud nyams su len tshul ni/ (nga ) 3)'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor yan/ nyams su blangs pa'i mtshams su rang gi snying ga'i chos 'byung nyis brtsegs kyi nang gi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi bam̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las/ de'i srog gi a thung*/ ya ra la wa dang bzhi'i ngo bo dbus su rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ mdun du dkar mo/ g.yon du ljang gu/ rgyab tu dmar mo/ g.yas su ser mo/ de lnga'i mtha' skor gyi yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/ rnal 'byor ma dmar mo sum cu rtsa gnyis/

'khor yug tu bskor bar bsam/ de nas dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlabs pa nas dkyus bzhin nyams su len pa/ bzlas pa'i tshe rnal 'byor ma dbus ma'i thugs kar chos 'byung nyis brtsegs/ bam̐ yig sngags phreng sogs bsgom/ 'di'i zab gnad/ (nga ) 4)rdo rje'i lus la yul chen sum cu so bdun rtsa khams yi ge tshang bar gnas/ de'i nus pa snying dbus na gnas pa'i rtsa khams la tshang bas/ rnal 'byor ma'i snying po oṃ gsum ma la yig 'bru so gnyis/ bam̐ yig gi srog gi a thung 'byung bzhi'i yi ge dang bcas pa byung*/ de rnams 'dir lhar skyes pa'i lus dkyil 'di ni/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la snyan brgyud 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs pa brgyud pa zam ma chad pa las byung ba kho na yin zhing*/ rjes 'brang yin lo ba phal cher gyis rna bar ma thos pa'i chos yin cing*/ de rigs dang zhus dag dgos pa'i yul med pa/ snod ldan nges pa can la chig brgyud du ston zhing bka' rgyas 'debs/ de ma rtogs pa rnams kyi rna ba'i lam du ming tsam yang mi grags par bya'o// snying dbus bzhugs pa'i mkha' spyod dga' ma de// snying nas bsgrub par 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor dag /snying gi gdams pa mchog 'dis tshim byas nas// snying ltar gces pas dam du sba bar mdzod// // ༄༅//

rje btsun yab yum la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i 'pho ba tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun bzhugs so// ༈ /gang gi khyod zhabs dran tsam gyis// gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa ma lus pa// 'jigs mdzad rje btsun dbang mo la// snying ga'i pad mor gus pas 'dud/ (cha)/'dir rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod kyi 'pho ba la/ yab dang thun mong ba dang*/ yum thun mong ma yin pa'i 'pho ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skyabs su 'gro ba nas brtsams te/ bsam mi khyab kyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin rdzogs par nyams su blang ngo*// de nas rang nyid thun mtshams kyi lha phyag mtshan med pa'i skur bsams la/ rang gi lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar rtsa dbu ma sbom phra sba lcags 'bring po tsam/ rtse mo je sbom la song ba/ dung gi sha kha lta bu tshangs bug la gtad do/ dkar khung skya tha ler yod par bsam/ dbu ma'i mas snar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor che chung de dang mthun pas kha bkab pa'i tshul du yod par bsam/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du ngo bo rang sems yin pa la rnam pa rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rgyan cha lugs ji lta ba 'phar la khad pa gar stabs ling ling bzhugs par bsam/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad kar mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma nyi ma zla ba 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du/ rang gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i rnam pa can rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba'i yum rdo rje phag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku can du bzhugs pa la/ gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin du bskor te bzhugs par bsam/ bla ma dam pa de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ skyabs yul rnams bsdus te rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim pas/ de nyid skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsgoms la/ rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal bas gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs pa ni/

dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs/ dgos med rgyud la skye bar= lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par= 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par= zhes pas gsol ba phur tshugs su 'debs so// de nas 'og rlung drag tu 'then pa dang mnyam du sems kyi bsam pa ni/ bshang sgo'i rlung g.yos pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la phog pas rang sems rje btsun mar gsal ba/ rtsa dbu ma'i nang la skar mda' brgyab pa ltar song ste tshangs bug nas bla ma bde mchog yab yum gyi thugs kar thim par bsam la rig pa 'dzin med du mdzod/ yang steng rlung rngubs pa dang mnyam du rang sems rnal 'byor mar gsal ba/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'thon/ tshangs bug nas zhugs te nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du byon par bsams la rlung kha sbyor ci thub 'dzin/ yang 'og rlung bskyod pa sogs gong gi dmigs pa tshar bdun la sogs pa bya'o// mthar thun bsdu ba'i tshe skyabs yul rnams mtha' nas 'od du zhu nas bla ma bde mchog yab yum la thim/ gdan khri yang 'od du zhu nas thim/ de nas bla ma yab yum sku je chung la song ste mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam du gyur/ rang gi tshangs bug nas rtsa dbu ma'i nang la zhugs/ snying ga'i thad du byon/ rje btsun ma la spyan gzigs/ rje btsun ma yang he ru ka la gyen du gzigs pas/ bde stong gi ye shes thugs rgyud la 'khrungs par bsam/ tshangs bug gi skar khung 'od dmar po sra zhing 'thas pa la 'od zer sna tshogs kyi rdo rje rgya gram gyis kha bcad pa bskal pa'i rlung gis kyang mi phigs par bsam pa ni sbyang ba'o// las la sbyar ba ni/ rang sems bla ma yab yum la thim/ de yang dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su gshegs par bsams la rig pa brjod med du 'jog gnyis pa rje btsun yum la brten pa yum rkyang gi 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor ni/

rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lte ba nas spyi gtsug gi bar la rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po sbom phra gong bzhin gsal btab pa'i mas snar chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum pa dbu ma dang dbyer med pa'i nang du rang sems bam̐ yig thig le dmar po che chung ril ma tsam 'phar la khad pa cig bsgom/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri pad zla 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par bzhugs pa la gnas gsum gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba de dag kyang 'ja' gur gyi dbus na bzhugs shing*/ me tog gi char chen po rgyun mi chad par 'bebs pa/ 'ja' mdung tshugs su zug cing spos kyi dri zhim po 'thul ba la sogs pa mkha' spyod dngos dang mtshungs par bsam/ de nas rang sems bam̐ yig tu gsal ba'i mdun gyi skyabs gnas rnams la lus longs spyod kyi mchod par bsams la/ badz+ra yo gi ni sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs kyis bstod/ gsol ba 'debs pa/ bla ma mkha' spyod rdo rje mkha' spyod ma la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag 'dzin blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes sogs gong bzhin gsol ba btab/ 'og rlung drag tu cher 'then te/ sems kyi bsam pa bam̐ yig dbu ma'i nang la thal te song ste tshangs bug nas 'thon/ bla ma rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig la thim par bsam pas sems 'dzin med du bzhag yang bam̐ yig thugs ka nas thon/ rang gi spyi bo nas dbu ma'i nang nas mar babs te chos 'byung gi nang du byung bar bsam/ yang 'og rlung 'then te rang sems bam̐ yig gam thig ler gsal ba dbu ma'i nang la song ba yang yang bya ba ni sbyang ba'o// las la sbyar ba ni/ 'chi ltas la sogs pa 'byung tshul bzhin byung ba'i tshe/ gang la yang zhen chags med par rang sems bla ma'i thugs kar thim/

bla ma rje btsun mar gsal ba yang mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du gshegs par bsams la dbyings rig bsre'o// ༈ / rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i nā ro mkha' spyod kyi mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i gser chos chig brgyud ma bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi ni/ thun mong ma yin pa'i mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i yang zab kyi gdams pa snyan nas snyan dang zhal du brgyud pa nyams su len par 'dod pas/ rgyas pa na ngag bzlas yid bzlas tshar rjes thun bsdu ba'i tshe bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor nyams su len pa'i tshab tu 'di nyams su len pa yin la/ bsdu na rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma pad+ma'i rnam pa ltar phra ba/ chu shing gi sdong po ltar drang ba/ rgya skyegs kyi me tog ltar dmar ba/ til mar gyi mar me ltar gsal ba ste chos bzhi dang ldan pa/ yas sna spyi gtsug tu zug par bsam/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo/ de gnyis ka sbom phra gro sogs 'bring po tsam yas sna spyi gtsug nas sba gug ltar mdun phyogs su 'khyogs nas sna bug g.yas g.yon du zug pa/ rtsa gsum ka'ang mas sna lte bar sleb pa/ lte ba'i rtsa gsum 'dzom par bam̐ yig dang rang sems dbyer med pa'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa gcig bsam/ de la sems bsam pa zhig gtad pas de las chu las chu bur rdol ba ltar/ rnal 'byor ma chung ngu zhig nur gyis chad/ rlung phyir rgyu ba dang lhan cig me stag yar pa ltar rtsa g.yas ro ma'i nang nas yar dmar khyug gis byon/ sna bug gi sgor sleb pa dang*/ de las de 'dra grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab pa nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'phros/ snod bcud thams cad khyab/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul zhing thugs kyi rgyud bskul/

de thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gyur nas/ skad cig nyid la tshur 'dus sna bug g.yon pa'i bu gar sleb pa dang*/ sngar 'phros pa'i rnal 'byor ma chung ngu me stag tsam de la thams cad thim/ de nyid rlung nang du 'jug pa dang lhan cig tu sna bug g.yon pa nas rtsa g.yon rkyang ma'i nang nas mar khyug gis byon/ rlung nang du gnas pa dang*/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma la thim par bsam zhing rlung ci thub bzung*/ de lta bu'i spro bsdu lan bdun nam gsum la sogs pa ci rigs pas lam sbyangs pa'i mthar/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma las 'od zer dmar po 'phros pas rang gi lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ yan lag rnams 'od du zhu nas lus kyi rdza ma la thim/ de nyid kyang 'od phung dmar por gyur/ de tsam na lte ba'i rang sems rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod la byon par chas/ steng phyogs su nar tsam nar tsam byon pas rtsa dbu ma dbu gtsug tu thim pas je thung je thung du gyur/ g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis kyi mas sne'ang gyen du 'dug pas rnal 'byor ma'i zhal (zhabs )mthil gnyis la 'byar ba gyen du byon pas je thung du gyur/ de nas rim bzhin snying ga dang mgrin pa'i thad sogs su rnal 'byor ma byon/ rim gyis rtsa gsum kyang de tsam du 'dus/ lus kyi ngo bo 'od kyi gong bu'ang smad nas rim bzhin yal nas der thim/ rang sems kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma spyi gtsug tu byon pa dang*/ mnyam du rtsa gsum lus 'od phung dang bcas pa thams cad rnal 'byor ma la sib kyis thim/ de'i rkyen gyis rnal 'byor ma de nyid kyang nam mkha' la me stag yar ba'am/ rtsal po ches mda' nam mkhar 'phangs pa ltar/ nam mkha'i dbyings blos mi 'khyud pa tsam nas yar ye re re byon/ mkha' spyod kyi gnas su phebs pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba'am du ba yal ba ltar chos sku stong nyid kyi ngang du thim par bsams la/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang du ji tsam gnas kyi bar du khong klod nas mnyam par 'jog

yang mkha' dbyings su rang sems rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam pa de nyid thol gyis byung*/ bya thur du babs pa lta bur byon nas rang gnas su byon/ phyi'i lus kyang sngar bzhin du grub par bsams la sngar gyi dmigs pa de nyid tshar nyer gcig gam bdun/ gsum la sogs pa skabs dang bstun pa bya'o// gdams pa 'di la chig 'dril du nyams len byas pas dus re zhig na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dngos sam tha mal gyi bud med sha dang mig dang skra dmar ser du yod pa zhig dang 'phrad nas des sgrub po 'di lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste/ dag pa mkha' spyod kyi gnas su skad cig la khrid nas 'ja' lus su gyur/ longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod la dbang sgyur sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas zhing du rgyu zhing dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams dang skal ba mnyam par 'gyur ro// gal srid rnal 'byor pa sgrub pa po brtson 'grus chung ba sogs kyis tshe 'dir mkha' spyod ma 'grub na/ 'chi khar 'di nyid 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor gyi tshul gyis nyams su blangs pas bar do med par mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur ba yin no// 'di nyid nyams len mdzad pa'i dpal ldan sa skya pa'i sngags 'chang mang po lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du byon pa'i gtam rgyud ngo mtshar ba ji snyed yod pa/ the tshom som nyi thams cad dang bral ba'i lam zab mo mthar thug pa 'di/ snying gi dkyil du gces par bzung nas nyams len chig dril la brtson par bya'o// 'di la ngor lugs kyi rjes 'brangs rnams rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho chung zhes zer/ sa skya rdzong lugs pa rnams nang gi rnal 'byor zhes zer/ 'di pa'i lugs kyis mkha' spyod bsgrub pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i snyan brgyud kyi gdams ngag zhes brjod/ 'di deng sang gi bar du gser gyi maṇ+ḍal nges pa can dang bcas te/ gdan thog gcig brgyud las mang bar mi ster ba'i bka' dang dam dog shin tu che bar mdzad pa yin no// 'di'i skabs su brgyud tshul lo rgyus mang po 'dug kyang gzhan du gsal/

dpal ldan sa skya pa'i snyan brgyud 'dzin pa'i ban+de blo gsal gyis 'phen yul sa'i sman ljongs o ḍi ya na'i ming can gyi gzhis kar mi dbang gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen dpal bzang po la snying nas gdams pa'i zab chos gu h+ya sa mā ya/ shu bhaṃ// ༈ /dhi/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi rim pa tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsung rgyun dge slong ring mo bas zin bris su bkod pa bzhugs so// ༈ /bla ma mchog dang rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i khrid kyi rim pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po lam log pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ 'gal rkyen med cing mthun rkyen tshang ba yid du 'ong ba'i gnas su stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ sa phyogs dag pa'i zhing khams baiḍūr+ya las grub pa las/ gser zhun mas mig mang ris su bres pa/ mnan na nem pa bteg na 'phar ba/ reg na bde ba dang ldan pa'i dbus su seṅge brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma zla ba'i gdan la/ rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs bzhin pa'i ḍā ma ru/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ sku mdog dmar po dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dkon mchog gsum gyi bdag nyid du mos la/ skyabs 'gro bzhi skor ci lcogs kyi bar bya'o// dpa' bo rdo rje chos de la bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum tshang*/ de'i phung po lnga rgyal ba rigs lnga'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la sangs rgyas/ de'i thugs rgyud kyi spangs rtogs chos/ tshigs khams khro bo khro mo'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa dge 'dun/ skyabs gsol tshar rjes de nyid rang la thim/ rig pa brjod med du bzhag

de la don gyi skyabs 'gro zhes bya ste/ sems nyid kyi ngo bo gsal tsam rig tsam yer tsam snang ba dge 'dun/ de'i ngo bo la bltas pas cir yang ma grub pa'i stong pa chos/ gsal tsam na stong*/ stong tsam na gsal bar snang ba'i zung 'jug sangs rgyas dkon mchog de thams cad brjod pa'am spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba bde ba chen po'i ngo bo'am/ rang bzhin bla ma ste/ sems skad cig ma'i steng du tshang ba'o// de la rig pa ci gnas zhig bzhag de nas lam dman pa las khyad par bya ba sems bskyed kyi 'khrid ni spyi dang mthun/ de rjes sems bskyed pas so// bskyed bya'i yul/ sems bskyed pa rang gi ngo bo smon 'jug gang du yang ma grub pa la mnyam par bzhag pa gang gnas bya/ de ni don dam pa'i sems bskyed pa'o// de nas 'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyang ba rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi 'khrid ni/ kyai rdo rje bzhin gsol 'debs yan chad brjod/ rdo rje sems dpa' de nyid shin tu dgyes te/ khyed legs par gnas pa la gnas pa yin no// zung 'jug he ru ka'i go 'phang thob par 'dod pas gnas pa 'di la legs par gnas par gyis shig dgyes shing gnang ba sbyin te de nyid spyi gtsug nas thim/ de nyid kyi ngang las rig pa bcos med du bzhag te de gsum gyi dang po gnyis thun mong dang*/ phyi ma thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro zhes bya'o// mthun rkyen tshogs gsog kyi byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ 'di gnyis bral ched du zhal shes gsum// zhes pa'i bsgom dus kyi bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi zhal shes ni/ gong gi gnas de'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bsgom/ sku mdog dmar por byas pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can no// de la brgyud pa'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can 'ba' zhig gis mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor du bskor/

de dag gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs/ de las 'od 'phros rang gi dbang thob pa'i bla ma nas/ ka kha yan chad bslab pa'i bla ma phyi ma/ snga ma'i dpe mtshon dus gsum skyabs yul med na phar bzhag go /yod tshad thams cad steng 'og bar gsum nas dpe dang bcas te bya'o// de dag re re la thim de dag re re'ang de thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor bsams la/ gang gi drin gyis sogs/ bla ma'i sku ni sogs kyis phyag dang*/ spro na brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs kyang bya/ puṣ+pe phyi/ bdud rtsi nang*/ rang gi snying ga nas ri dwags can sogs gsang ba mchod yul bla ma sogs ma dmigs pa'i de kho nas mchod/ de nas maṇ+ḍal rgyu 'byor sogs dang bstun tshom bu bdun ma sogs gang 'os/ rgyu rang gis dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge rtsa/ lus longs spyod/ rnam pa ri rab sogs su bsam pa rgyu/ de nas ku sā li'i tshogs gsog de yang ku sā li zhes pa bla ma gong ma'i gsung las dge ba can te/ paṇ+ḍi ta ltar mkhas par ma bsten/ rnal 'byor pa ltar brtul zhugs can du ma bsten/ tha mal pa bzhin sdig spyod du ma bsten/ phyi rol longs spyod sogs ched du mi gnyer/ rang rgyud dge ba'i chos la sbyor ba'i don yin gsungs/ de'i tshogs bsags gi rgyu ni/ gzhan med pa rang gi lus nyid yin pa'i phyir/ ku sā li'i tshogs bsag tu grags/ de la rang gi mdun du ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum bsam/ lag pa g.yas su ye shes kyi ral gri rno ngar dang bcas pa byung ste/ rang gi smin mtshams nas ltag pa'i klad sgo'i bar rbad kyis bcad/ sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du bskyur/ de je cher song ste blos 'khyud tshad mkha' khyab tu song*/ de nas rim bzhin rkang g.yas dum bu gsum/ g.yon gsum/ ro smad nang khrol lag g.yon dum bu gsum du gtubs/ de nas ro stod mgo lhag mthar lag g.yas ral gri dang bcas pa bskyur/

de la dmigs nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis rlabs/ thun mong gi rnam pa kha dog dkar/ rig bya 'jam pa sogs/ thun mong ma yin pa'i rnam pa/ gzugs 'dod pa la gzugs/ sgra 'dod pa la sgra/ nor bu 'dod pa la nor bu sogs gang la gang 'dod 'byung bar bsam/ mchod pa'i lha mos thod pas rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la 'bul/ ngag tu oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod/ de mnyes par gyur pas smin mtshams dang*/ zhal 'dzum mdangs/ thugs ka rnams su sems gtad la/ rtsa rgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs so bdag sogs nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la re sa ltos sa khyed rnams las med do// byin gyis rlobs shig ces sogs gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab/ bla ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po oṃ yig gi rnam pa can rang gi dpral bar thim/ bum dbang*/ lus dri/ sprul sku sogs 'gre/ mthar dbang bzhi pa'i mthar yang gsol ba btab pas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams rtsa bla la thim/ de yang sku'i stod smad nas yar mar thim/ thugs ka'i thad du sangs rgyas byang sems sogs skyabs yul kun 'dus/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi 'od dang ldan pa'i 'od phung du gyur/ de yang rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas/ sbyang gzhi rang gi lus ngag sogs sbyangs/ sbyangs 'bras dkon mchog gsum mngon du gyur song snyam pa'i ngang du rig pa bcos med du bzhag 'gyu na de'i ngo bo la bltas tshe gsal rig tsam bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ de gang du yang ma grub pa'i stong pa bla ma chos kyi sku/ de zung du 'jug pa bla ma longs spyod rdzogs sku/ dbyer mi phyed pa bla ma ngo bo nyid sku ste/ bla ma sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi zhal mngon du mjal song snyam pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag yang 'gyu na/ de ltar mnyam par bzhag pa sogs nan tan du bya'o// de nas thun du gcod na/ lus gnad ma bshig cing*/

dus gsum gyi bsam pa drag pos bar ma chod par bsngo ba/ smon lam/ bkra shis/ spyod lam kun tu gzugs snang tshad bla ma sku rdo rje'i ngo bo/ sgra thams cad bla ma gsung rdo rje'i ngo bo/ snang ba thams cad bla ma thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgom par bya/ de ltar byas pas mtshan dus rmi lam du yang nyams len dang mi 'bral bar 'byung*/ de'i nyin mos mtshan mo/ mtshan mos nyin mo la rgyas btab pa dge sbyor bogs che/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku min kyang bar do'i rten la sangs rgyas pa'i rgyu bla na med par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ gang gis nyams su len par byed pa'i gang zag des nyams su blang bar bya ba'i lam/ lam des thob pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum las/ dang po la smin lam du 'jug rung gi gang zag dang*/ grol lam bsgom rung gi gang zag gnyis/ dang po la/ sgo dog pa'i dbang du byas na/ lū nag gang rung gi dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang thob pa dgos te/ 'bring du na dril bu sogs bde mchog gi rigs gzhan gang yang rung ba/ yang pa'i dbang du byas na ma rgyud kyi he ru ka gang yang rung ba'i dkyil 'khor du smin byed kyi dbang thob pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ dbang des smin cing 'di'i byin rlabs sogs thob pa/ spyir dam tshig dang sdom pa ldan pa'o// gnyis pa lam la dngos dang*/ de'i cha rkyen gnyis/ dang po la bskyed rdzogs gnyis las/ dang po la/ bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs dpyod pa dang*/ dpyad don nyams su myang ba gnyis/ dang po la/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang*// zhes sogs rnal 'byor bcu gcig la sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sogs ngo sprad pa'i bshad pa rgyas par gnang*/ gnyis pa de'i don nyams su len pa la ni/ gong gi sangs rgyas rdo rje chos thim pas rang gi snying gar e yig nyis brtsegs sogs nas bzlas pa'i bar bya/ slar nga rgyal bslab pa ni/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba la nga rgyal 'dzin par bslabs te/

sangs rgyas nga rgyal sogs/ rnam pa la bslab pa la gnyis kyi dang po/ rgyan med la bslab pa ni/ smin mtshams su spyan dbus ma la sems 'dzin/ de yang mtha' skya ba sogs/ khro bo rnams la spyan g.yon gyen blang dang*/ khro mo rnams la g.yas gyen blang du bshad pas phyi ma bzhin gsal na gsal te 'phro bcad pa sogs nas ngag tu brjod pa/ bri ba'i bar/ bsam gtan gyi dug ni kun po ste/ khyag 'og tu chu rgyug pa bzhin sems kha la gnas pa 'dra ba la gting rtog pa phra mo ste/ rnam rtog rkun po bsgom pa bar chad kyi bdud bya ba yin gsung*/ mdun du dmigs rten bzhag ste/ spyan dbus ma dang phar spo tshur spo byed dgos pa zhi gnas bying ba sogs kyi skyon spong*/ dmigs pa gzhan spo thub pa sogs yin gsung*/ de nas spyan g.yon sogs mngon rtogs las 'byung ba bzhin gyis gcer bu la sems 'dzin pa'o// gnyis pa rgyan can la bslab pa ni/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga sogs la sems 'dzin pa'o// rdzogs rim la chos 'byung gi grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rtsa dbu ma'i mas snar dga' ba 'khyil pa dmar po dang*/ smin mtshams su zug pa'i dga' 'khyil dkar po la sems gtad/ rlung gnad can bzung*/ yas mar nas rim gyis byung*/ bya yar 'phur dang mar 'bab kyi dpe mdzad snying kha'i thad du 'dzom/ mthar 'dres/ dkar dmar ldang chags/ de yang dbu ma'i stong pa 'dres/ brjod bral du bzhag gsungs/ rdzogs rim gyi khrid byed na/ yab yum gnyis ka la brten pa thun mong ba dang*/ yul rkyang pa la brten pa'i thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po rje btsun rin chen grags pa dang*/ yar klung pa'i yi ge la brten nas gnang*/ gnyis pa sems dpa' chen po'i gsung gi rgyun las 'byung ba ltar ro// lam gyi yan lag pra sen dbab pa sogs gsum/ gsum pa lam des thob pa'i 'bras bu dman 'bring rab gsum las/ dang po zhi rgyas sogs/

gnyis pa rdzu 'phrul gyis nam mkha' la 'gro ba/ sangs rgyas las chos nyan nus pa/ tshe nyi zla dang mnyam pa ci 'dod pa'i longs spyod nam mkha' las 'byung ba/ shin tu mdzes pa'i gzhon nur gyur pa bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod dang ldan pa/ rten de la phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mngon du byed nus pa sogs yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i mkha' spyod kyi go 'phang ngo*// gsum pa bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gi sa'o// lam dngos bstan pa dag gi khar/ yang zab kyi khyad par snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa/ rjes 'brang yin lo pa phal pa la ma grags pa lus dkyil thun mong ma yin pa dang*/ thun mong ba yin pa'i mkha' spyod sgrub pa/ 'og tu 'phos pa'i 'pho ba rnams ni/ bla ma man ngag dang ldan pa mnyes par byas pa las 'byung gi/ gzhan du ni nam yang ma yin no// de ltar lam de nyams su len pa'i gang zag dbang po yang rab kyis ni/ gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin par byas/ rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo 'phrod pa'i nges pa brtan pos/ bsgom bzlas ye ma chag par brtson par bya/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu gnyis la mchod gtor gyi mnyes par byas pa tsam gyis/ nam zhig na rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal gyi bud med du sprul te/ rnal 'byor pa de'i rtsar byon la/ de rnal 'byor ma yin par lung bstan pa bzhin/ de la gsol ba btab pas rnal 'byor pa'i lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste/ lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du mngon sum du 'khrid la der sleb pa tsam gyis zag bcas kyi lus zag med du gnas gyur/ rje btsun mas yongs su 'dzin pa mdzad de/ zab lam gyi rjes su 'dzin/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing mang por chos nyan nus/ rgyu de la brten nas sa bcu gsum mngon du gyur pa'o// dbang po 'bring gis ni/ oṃ gsum ma'i yi ge'i grangs kyi bsnyen pa gcig gnyis gsum tsam byang ba'i sgo nas gzhi'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin par byed/

de rjes man ngag las byung ba'i sin+dhu ra'i sgrub pa tshul bzhin byas pa'i/ sin+dhu ra'i thig le nang re bzhin du dpral bar btab nas 'jig rten gyi khams nyul pas de gang gi dpral bar 'phos pa'i bud med de rnal 'byor ma yin nges pas the tshom spangs te g.yon nas bskor ba byed pa/ rab spyi bor len pa ci mnyes sgrub pa sogs kyis sgo nas gsol ba btab pas de nyid kyis mkha' spyod du khrid par 'gyur ro// gang zag dbang po tha mas ni tshe 'dir mkha' spyod dngos su ma 'grub kyang*/ 'chi khar rnal 'byor mas rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur la/ de yang ches myur ba'i 'phro ba'i rnal 'byor la brten nas bar dor 'jigs skrag med par mkha' spyod du 'gro ba yin zhing*/ 'pho ba la yab yum zhal sbyor la brten pa dang*/ yum rkyang la brten pa gnyis yod pa la sbyang ba/ bsgom pa'i tshad/ 'chi ltas byung na brtags te slar 'tsho ba'i thabs/ bsring ma thub na las la sbyar ba sogs dgos pa ni/ kun dang thun mong ma yin pa'i gdung brgyud kho na las byung ba'i khyad chos yin pas bla ma'i zhal shes dgos shing*/ snying gi dkyil du bcang bar bya'o gsung*/ de las kyang dbang po cung zad rtul na/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos sku'i ngang nas bar dor langs nas bar dor yid kyi lus su grub pa na/ rje btsun ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len byed pa'i nyams 'char/ de'i tshe rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pas seṅge'i khri la rnal 'byor ba de nyid bkod de me tog gi char sna tshogs/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur bla bre/ lha rdzas kyi dri bzang po rol mo ji snyed pa'i sku dang bcas pas mkha' spyod du 'khyer bar 'gyur la/ dbang po shin tu tha shal gyis kyang*/ smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar/ skye ba brgyud nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur ro// zhes pa 'di ni mtshan yongs su grags pa bka' drin mnyam med tshar pa chos kyi rje blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la/
lam 'di'i cha lag phal mo che thob pa'i dge slong ring mo pas yid la zin pa'i gsung rgyun khag che ba 'ga' zhig brjed thor btab pa'o// ༈ /ai//

rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ma'i mngon rtogs la brten nas sbyang gzhi sbyang tshul gyi man ngag shin tu zab pa rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje'i gsung las byung ba bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru badz+ra yo gi nī bh+yaḥ sku gsum lam du byed pa'i man ngag rdo rje rnal 'byor ma yi mngon rtogs la brten nas lam nyams su blang bar bya ba la/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu dang gsum las/ dang po gang du skye 'gyur las bsags te 'chi ba/ de sdod 'byung 'gyur gyi sngon dus srid pa'i sha tshugs te bar srid grub pa'i dus/ las kyis 'phangs pa'i 'bras bu skye ba len pa dang gsum/ dang po las sna tshogs gsog pa dang*/ 'chi ba gnyis so// dang po/ las gsog pa'i yul dag ma dag bar ma gsum la brten nas/ las dge mi dge/ lung ma brten gsum bsag go /gnyis pa la rim gyis 'chi ba dang*/ gcig char du 'chi ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ las sna tshogs gsog pa'i skyes bu de 'chi ba'i tshe na/ tshe dang bsod nams dang las rnams zad de rkyen dbang du ma song bar 'byung ba rnams rim gyis bsdus te 'chi ba'o// de yang 'byung ba sdud pa'i tshe lte ba'i rtsa mdud 'jig gzugs phung dang*/ mig dbang dang*/ mig gi rnam shes dang*/ yul gzugs rnams 'od gsal du 'jug chu sdud pa'i dus su snying ga'i rtsa mdud 'jig tshor phung dang rna ba'i dbang po dang rnam shes/ yul dri rnams 'od gsal du 'jug go /rlung sdud pa'i dus su dpral ba'i rtsa mdud 'jig 'du byed kyi phung po dang*/ lce'i dbang po dang*/ rnam shes/ lus kyi dbang po dang*/ lce'i rnam shes dang*/ lus kyi rnam shes dang*/ yul dang ro dang reg bya rnams 'od gsal du 'jug go /nam mkha'i rlung sdud pa'i dus su rtsa mdud kun 'jig rnam shes kyi phung po/ yid kyi dbang po dang*/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa rnams dang*/ yul chos rnams 'od gsal du 'jug go

/de yang snang ba la thim/ de yang snang ba mched pa la thim/ de yang snang ba nyer thob la thim/ de yang thams cad stong pa 'od gsal la thim par gyur te/ de ni rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal zhes bya ba sems can kun la 'char yang ngo ma shes pas lan/ man ngag med pas lan/ nyams myong dang 'dres pa med pas lan/ bla ma'i bka' drin dran pas dus rgyun du gsol ba 'debs so// gnyis pa bar srid grub dus ni/ da len rgyu'i skye ba phyi ma dang*/ 'di nas shi ba gnyis kyi bar du yid kyi lus krang nge grub bo// de yang da len rgyu'i lus de'i mdog dang dbyibs su yod do// de'i tshe tshad zhag bdun yin/ bar dor gnas pa yun ring tshad ni bdun bdun bzhi bcu zhe dgu'o// de nas ni nges par skye gnas rnyed par ro// yun thung na ni bdun dang po la rnyed par 'gyur ro// ma rnyed na yang 'chi bar 'gyur ro// bdun phrag gnyis pa la rnyed dam/ des na da lta bdun tshigs byed/ dge rtsa byed pa de phan yon shin tu che'o// gsum pa skye ba len pa ni/ bar srid des pha ma kun sbyor byed pa mthong nas phor skye na pha la sdang zhing ma la chags par 'gyur/ mor skye na ma la sdang shing pha la chags par 'gyur/ gang ltar yang pha las brgyud de ma'i mngal du 'jug par 'gyur ro// de yang bdun phrag bzhi bcu thim ste zla dgu ngo bcu mngal du skyed bsring shing gnas pa la/ bar srid de 'byung bzhi bsdus nas/ stong pa bzhi 'od gsal du thim nas 'chi ba dang*/ ma'i mngal du 'jug pa dus mtshungs so// de nas ma'i mngal du thams cad stong pa 'od gsal du bdun phrag lnga gnas te/ nur nur po la zla ba gcig dang zhag lnga'o// de nas snang ba nyer thob la bdun phrag lnga gnas te/ mer mer po la zla ba gcig dang zhag lnga'o// de nas snang ba mched pa la bdun phrag lnga gnas te/ gor gor po la zla ba gcig de nas snang ba la bdun phrag lnga ste/ ltar ltar po la zla ba gcig

de ltar zla ba lnga nas mkhrang 'gyur nya'i rnam pa lta bu'o// de nas bdun phrag lnga nas rlung rgyu bas sems sems 'byung gi rtog pa du ma 'phro zhing rtsa rnams chags par byed do// pha ma'i byang sems 'bru gsum gsum las gcig yar song bas spyi bor haṃ gi rnam pa'i rtsa gcig chags/ de yang pha'i byang sems bzhi 'gyur gyis mang zhing ma'i nyung ngo*// 'bru gnyis mar song bas lte 'og sor bzhir aṃ gi rnam pa'i rtsa gcig chags so// des ma'i byang sems bzhi 'gyur gyi mang la pha'i nyung ngo*// 'bru gnyis snying gar kha sbyor gyi gnas de hūm̐ gi rnam pa'i rtsa gcig chags te/ pha ma gnyis ka'i byang sems mnyam pa ste/ des sems kyi rten byed do// de nas spyi bo nas ro rkyang gnyis dbu ma'i g.yas g.yon mar song zhing*/ mgrin pa/ snying ga lte ba/ lte 'og sogs rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mo'i bar dang*/ phan tshun mdud pa las rtsa 'dab rnams chags so// de nas bdun phrag lnga ste zla ba gcig dang zhag lnga nas me drod che zhing ba spu dang skra sen skye'o// de nas bdun phrag lnga ste zla ba gcig dang zhag lnga nas dbang po'i skye mched rnams dod do// de nas bdun phrag lnga ste zla ba gcig dang zhag lnga nas sa ltar sra zhing gzugs yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro// de rnams dril bas zla ba dgu dang zhag bcu 'byung ba yin no// de nas zla dgu ngo dang bcu nas skye'o zhes grags so// skye gnas yul 'khor longs spyod sogs kyi gnas tshul rnams zhar la ngo sprod par sla bas 'dir ma bris so// gnyis pa sbyang gzhi de sbyong byed rnal 'byor ma'i mngon rtogs dang sbyar na/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i mngon par rtogs pa la/ tshogs bsags pa/ sa bon bsgom pa/ sku bskyed pa'o// dang po la/ bsod nams dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o// dang po la bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'i yul skyabs 'gro dang*/

sems bskyed kyi dmigs rten dang*/ tshogs gsog dngos kyi dmigs rten/ rdo rje chos bsgom pa des/ las gsog pa'i yul dag ma dag bar ma gsum sbyong bar byed/ skyabs 'gro dang*/ sems bskyed dang*/ rdo rje chos la gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig brjod pa'i cha lus ngag yid gsum rtse gcig tu dril nas ma yengs par bsgoms pa des/ las dge mi dge bar ma gsum gsog pa de sbyong bar byed do// gnyis pa sa bon bsgom pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs gsog pa bla ma rdo rje chos rang gi smin mtshams su thim pa la/ lus ngag yid gsum ma yengs par bsgom pa des/ las dge mi dge bar ma gsum gsog pa'i mi de'i 'chi ba sbyong bar byed/ de rjes mi dmigs par bsgoms pas 'chi ba 'od gsal du 'tshang rgya bar byed/ de rjes e yig bsgoms pas gang du skye 'gyur gyi ma dang*/ chos 'byung bsgoms pas ma'i mngal gyi bag chags sbyong bar byed/ rdo rjes a dang zla ba bsgoms pas pha dang ma'i khu ba sbyong bar byed/ de'i steng du bam̐ yig bsgoms pas bar srid sbyong bar byed/ kha dog dmar po bsgoms pas bar srid skye gnas la chags pa sbyong bar byed/ de'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor bas mngal gyi gnas skabs rnams sbyong bar byed do// gsum pa sku bskyed pa ni/ mi dmigs pa'i ngang las skad cig gis lha mo'i skur bsgoms pas gang du skye ba de sbyong bar byed/ de yang pad gdan dang nyi gdan bsgoms pas snod kyi 'jig rten sbyong bar byed/ 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan mas 'khor ba sbyong bar byed/ rgyan dang phyag mtshan bsgoms pas nor rdzas rnams sbyong bar byed/ go cha bsgoms pas skye mched rnams sbyong bar byed/ de la ye shes pa bstim pas/ rnam shes yongs su rdzogs pa de sbyong bar byed/ dbu rgyan rang chas su yod pas rang rig la dbang byed pa de sbyong bar byed/ gsum pa sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu ni/

de ltar bsgoms pas 'chi ba chos skur 'tshang rgya bar byed/ bar dor longs skur 'tshang rgya bar byed/ skye ba sprul skur 'tshang rgya bar byed do// de ltar ngo sprad de bsgoms pa'i gnad zab mo 'di ni/ rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa mkhyen rab chos rje'i zhal las byung ba'i gdams pa yi ger bkod pa'o// ༈ / nā ro mkha' spyod kyi rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyams len la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sems 'dzin zung 'brel du gtong tshul mthong grol lde mig bzhugs so// ༈ /swasti sid+dhaṃ/ mkha' spyod zhing gi rdo rje btsun mo yi// nye lam nā ro ta pa'i thugs kyi bcud// 'jam mgon sa skya'i bla chen gser chos mchog /slob bshad 'dzin mkhas rim brgyud gsang ba'i gtam// gnad 'gag sgro 'dogs bcad nas snying po ru// don bzung nyams su bstar byed grol lam khrid// rtogs dka'i mtsho las sgrol nus phyag bzhes grus// dam pa'i bzhed srol nor bu 'di na 'dren// de la 'dir bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i gsung rab mtha' dag gi mchog tu gyur pa nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i yang rtse rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde'i nang nas shin tu zab pa rnal 'byor gsang mtha'i 'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud kyi bcud phyung ba rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rdzogs kyi lam zab mo rje btsun rdo rje btsun mo nyid kyis 'phags yul paṇa grub kun gyi gtsug rgyan nā ro ta pa la dngos su gnang*/ des kyang 'phags bod kyi slob ma grags chen gzhan su la'ang ma stsal bar bal po pham thing pa gcen 'jigs med grags pa dang gcung ngag dbang grags pa mched gnyis la chig brgyud du gnang ba rje btsun sa skya pa chen por bka' babs pa lcags ri mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum mam klu pa'i gser chos bcu bzhir grags pa'i nang tshan nas mchog sgrub pa'i man ngag shin tu zab pa nā ro mkha' spyod kyi skor zhes grags che bas/

thos lo'i ming tsam don du gnyer ba'i dbang dang byin rlabs dbye ba ma phyed par rang bzo'i sin+dhu ra'i byin rlabs dang yig rnying gi lung kha yar dge zhal bo jo dwags shangs phyogs su'ang thor bu byung*/ sa skya'i rjes 'brang gong dkar ba phyogs la gsan yig rgya mtshor byin rlabs gsan tshul 'dug kyang deng sang dar po med/ rdzong chung par lung rgyun tsam las byin rlabs khrid dang chag med kyi rgyun phyis rim gyis nub/ ngor pa rnams la thun mong ba'i khrid ma chad tsam mus phyogs su yod par grags/ rgyu mtshan de dag la brten gdams pa yongs su rdzogs pa tshad ma bzhi ldan chad med kha'u brag rdzong pa'i lugs 'dzin rnams las gzhan du med par snang bas gdung brgyud rim pa dang yar klung pa khu dbon las snyan nas snyan dang zhal nas zhal du brgyud pa'i mkha' 'gro'i kha rlangs can rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rje'i gsung rgyun thams cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis reg zig tu mdzad pa'i khrid yig chen mo 'dir/ bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs gcod pa bskyed rim gyi bya ba dang*/ bcad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin gyi bya ba gnyis zung 'brel du mdzad pa'i dbang du btang zhing*/ gsang 'dus dang*/ bde mchog 'jigs byed sogs la'ang 'di dang dbyibs 'dra rung byung na'ang deng sang khrid rkyang las rnam bshad gtong ba'i rgyun phal cher nub/ lugs srol 'dir gdul bya dbang po rab 'bring yan la zung 'brel du gnang ba'i phyag srol ma nub cing*/ mkhan chen ngag dbang chos grags kyis mdzad pa'i khrid rkyang gi tshul du mdzad 'dug pa dus kyi dbang gis mi rnams blo'i mthu zhan pas lam 'dir mos shing dbang po rtul ba'i rigs rjes su 'dzin par dgongs pa chos rgyun spel mi nus pa'i nyams len tsam byed pa la des skabs don nges par yang 'grub rjes 'brang du rlom pa la las sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang bcad don nyams len gnyis ngos ma zin pa'i 'dra 'dres sna tshogs kyis phyag len 'chal ba'ang byung tshad du snang ba de 'dra'i nyes pa khegs shing 'chad nyan gyi rgyun la phan pa'i ched du rnam bshad dang sems 'dzin zung 'jug ma 'dres par gtong ba'i phyag len la spyir dwags brgyud pa sogs rtsing por spyod pa mang pos byin rlabs kyis dbang go gcod pa/

sdom gsum du/ rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs ni// mar pa lho brag pa la med// ces lo paṇa yongs grags rnams kyis dbang go byin rlabs kyis gcod pa med par gsungs shing*/ de dag phyogs mthun par thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rin po che dang rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa sogs tshad ldan gyi mkhas grub thams cad bzhed pa yin la/ khyad par lugs srol 'di la sa skya'i 'jam mgon rjes 'brang rnams kyi phyag bzhes su sngon 'gro 'khor lo sdom pa lū nag dril gsum lta bu yab bka' gang rung gi rdul tshon dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor ci rigs par dbang bzhi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa thob pa/ gal te bde mchog gi rigs kyi dbang ma thob kyang kyai rdor bka' babs bzhi sogs mdor na bde dgyes kyi rigs gang yang rung ba'i dbang thob pa'i snod ldan rnams la/ thog mar rgyun khyer gyi mngon rtogs 'dzin du bcug yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcu gang rung dang 'brel na rab/ de min dus gang yang rung bar sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes mdzad pa'i mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam gyi yi ge'i steng nas phyag len 'khrul pa med pa'i byin rlabs bya/ de nas bzung rgyun khyer nyams len dang bcas dam bca' gang byas kyi oṃ gsum ma chag med du bzla/ 'di pa'i gdul bya dbang po rab 'bring tha ma'i tha ma ste bzhir bshad pa thams cad kyis thun mong du nyams su blang bya/ rje brtse ba chen pos/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myong*// tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bsgom// 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs// ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin// bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor dang*// spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes pa 'di nyid 'chad pa la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sems 'dzin gnyis ka byung zhing*/

dngos bstan 'di la sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i rtsa ba byas/ bcad don nyams len la go bde sdoms tshig tu byed na sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum/ dang po la/ thun mong thun mong min pa'i thun mong bar// dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag las 'bras dang*// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs thun mong ma yin par// skyabs sems rdor sems bla ma'i rnal 'byor khrid// dngos gzhir bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi bskyed pa'i skabs// bya ba byed can gnyis las phyi ma'i grangs// nga rgyal rnam pa gnyis kyi rnam pa la// spyi dang bye brag lus dkyil sems 'dzin pa// rdzogs pa'i rim par gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum// gnyis par chos nyid dngos dang brgyud nas ston// phyi mar chags can chags bral rnam pa gnyis// chags bral rlung sems dbu mar bsdu bsgom zung*// bsgom pa bde ba dang ni stong pa bsgrub// gsung ba 'bras bu yan lag bdun ldan thob// bsam mi khyab bya mjug bsdus char chos ston// zhes go bar brjod nas thun mong ba'i sngon 'gro gsung ngag dang blo sbyong sogs zhu myong na btang snyoms su bzhag dmigs rkang dang po rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi nyal ba ldang ba bdud rtsi myang ba gsum la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs bcad nas bcad don nyams su len pa'i sngon 'gro'i sa bcad bzhi po blangs te skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa gtong ngo*// nyal ldang bdud rtsi gsum gyi dmigs pa'ang de ga'i dus su nyams len dgos pas nyan chos tsam gyis mi chog cing des mtshon rnam bshad kyi go don so so'i dmigs pa gang byung gi nyams su len dgos/ nub gnyis par tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor gyi skyabs 'gro la sgro 'dogs bcad nas rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas kyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ khrid ma grol bar du thun bzhi nges par dgos shing dmigs rkang sngon ma tsho ma chags pa'i steng gsar pa nan tan gyis bsgom/

nub gsum par bla ma'i rnal 'byor la sgro 'dogs bcad nas maṇ+ḍal gyi khrid du grags pa gnyis bral 'chad dus kyi zhal shes dang po dang gnyis pa'i sems 'dzin gtong*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor thun mong de thob nyin thun gcig tsam las mthar chags su bsgom mi dgos/ nub bzhi par mthar thug gi sbyangs gzhi ngos bzung ste gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma dbang du 'dus par brten lhan skyes kyi rnal 'byor mas byin gyis rlabs pas rtogs pa nang nas 'char tshul la sgro 'dogs bcad don mngon rtogs rgyun khyer tshig zin ltar bshad nas bzlas pa dam bca'i grangs dang mthun pa chag med dgos tshul yid bzlas zhar byung rdzogs rim rnams kyi ngo grangs tsam byas nas nga rgyal gyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ 'di nas bzung thun mthar bsam mi khyab thun mong ba'i mjug sdud re'ang mdzad/ nub lnga par skye shi bar do gsum sbyong ba dang bdag gi gzhi sbyangs par sgro 'dogs bcad nas rnam pa spyi'i sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub drug par gzhi bsgyur ba'i kha ṭ+wām̐ ga'i mtshon don yan la sgro 'dogs bcad nas spyan dbus ma'i sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub bdun par dbu skra nas dga' ba bcu drug rgyas tshul yan la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i spyan g.yas g.yon nas zhal gyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub brgyad par rigs bdag dang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus tshul la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i mgul pa nas nu 'bur bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub dgu par 'gro ba dag pa dang dpa' bo dang dpa' mos byin gyis rlabs par sgro 'dogs bcad nas phyag gnyis kyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub bcu par pho nya gsum bsre dang go cha bcing ba gnyis la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i rked pa nas zhabs kyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ pho nya gsum bsre 'di la tshogs bshad pa rnams la ma grags pa'i lus dkyil gyi man ngag yod pa slob ma gcig gam snod dang ldan nges gsum las mi mang bar gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas ster ba las khrom tshogs su mi mdzad pas dus der dmangs ma grol nas gnang ngam slar khrid rdzogs pa'i rjes la btang kyang chog

nub bcu gcig par ngag bzlas dang yid bzlas gnyis la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i thod skam nas mgul rgyan gyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub bcu gnyis par zhar byung rdzogs rim dang por sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i dpung rgyan nas ye shes kyi me dpung gi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub bcu gsum par zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis par sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i lus dkyil gyi gtso bo'i spyan dbus ma'i sems 'dzin gtong*/ zhar byung 'di gnyis la tshig mang ba med kyang*/ do nub nas bzung yid bzlas kyi mjug tu dmigs pa nan tan bsgom dgos pas rnam bshad kyang tshar gsum mdzad/ nub bcu bzhi par spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la sgro 'dogs bcad nas spyan gnyis nas zhal gyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub bco lnga par kha zas nas sbyin sreg gi bar la sgro 'dogs bcad pa'i mgul nas zhabs kyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub bcu drug par tshes bcu dang gtor mar sgro 'dogs bcad nas rgyan cha lugs kyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub bcu bdun par gang zag dbang po rab kyi grol tshul la sgro 'dogs bcad nas 'khor gyi lha so drug gi spyan dbus ma'i sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub bco brgyad par gang zag dbang po 'bring sin+dhu ra'i sgrub par sgro 'dogs bcad nas spyan gnyis nas zhabs kyi bar gyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ nub bcu dgu par gang zag dbang po tha ma 'chi khar rnal 'byor mas rjes su 'dzin pa dang myur ba 'pho ba'i phan yon 'chi ltas bzlog thabs sogs la sgro 'dogs bcad nas rgyan gyi sems 'dzin gtong*/ 'pho ba yod tshul tsam gsung ba las dmigs pa mang po la mi mdzad/ don gnyer can re gnyis la skabs 'dir mi ston par rdzogs rim gyi 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i mjug tu gnang zhing*/ de yang dus gcig la yab yum gang rung gi 'pho dmigs gcig phab nas cig shos slar mdzad/ 'dir khrid bsgom mkhan gcig gam mang mtha' yang gsum gyi dbang du byas nas lus dkyil gyi sems 'dzin bkod pa yin gyi/

khrid bsgom mkhan mang po yod na lus dkyil khrom chos su mi gtong ba'i skabs sems bdun po'i tshab la dngos gzhi'i sems 'dzin rnams phral nas zhabs tu gtong ngam yang sems 'dzin bdun du bcad nas nyi ma gnyis la thun gcig po dog bldabs pas gtong lugs skabs thob sbyar 'di mi gsum tshun la zhag nyer lnga dang*/ de las mang bar zhag nyer gsum tsam la grub pa'i 'bring po'i dbang du byas kyi sems 'dzin la gnad du bsnun pa'i zla lhag tsam byed na sgro 'dogs gcod pa'i bshad pa'ang cung zad nyung du btang nas grangs mang du spel/ bsdus pa zhag bcu gsum tsam la grub pa byed na sgro 'dogs gcod pa'ang dkyus ring du byas nas sems 'dzin dang lhan du rdzogs pa byed/ rdzogs rim la sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang sems 'dzin nyis sbrags su gtong rgyu med pas khrid gzhung bzhin/ nub nyi shu pa rlung sems dbu mar bsdu ba/ nub nyer gcig pa rlung lus la gnas pas bde ba sgrub pa/ nub nyer gnyis pa rlung sems la zhugs pas 'ja' lus sgrub pa/ nub nyer gsum pa 'pho ba/ nub nyer bzhi pa zhal shes gsum pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab gser gyi maṇ+ḍal dang bcas chig brgyud las snod ldan gnyis gsum tsam la ston kyang re re nas ston pa las lhan cig tu ye mi snang*/ nub nyer lnga pa phyogs las rnam rgyal gyi spyod pa sogs la brten nas 'bras bu grub pa dang tshar chos rgyun gyi nyams len snying por dril tshul bstan pa yin/ chos nyid dngos su ston pa rje btsun yab yum dang thun mong ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i skabs su yongs grags kyi khrid 'di la par bkab mi mdzad cing brgyud 'debs su/ lte ba'i pad+mor rlung lnga'i ti la ka zhes sogs kyi dgongs don gyi nyams khrid kyang rnal 'byor dbang phyug yar klungs pa dang kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i yi ge la ltos dgos pas sa skya yin tshad kyi rna bar ma grags pa yin/
